Peter,
I just heard **_[Jamie Raskins plan to overturn the election if Trump wins](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=89ea8bdfcef641ee8de3a1b1b40a893a&_e=hDefVIFHn4yAqOugcO8PtFJo7DF1SM5G7LVI7RKSPrfi2Gh4UDIuRKp1O9o6p7cg8BsETyF_Mlk2PKa29bCAKqRpFaO0c9qLvHGUJlQncD76dSVYTfuw2siUynQ_kL9S1PhflOqiL1WaK9Dz50YdEm5hBMq0FiGcc2kwpa2_swU5eVj75NdVcpgIqQPMw9u24pNwx7JSzua25l0VtNYZVncRfFoMwUiX0BmfFtiPNLR7X7cqsNIv452EjO5rQsN40vtGFPg8Ch7ZBINHOVr4aJaIoCktJQZJSRpp2RAwWN6WYzr2YnhGAWLuNrGU90qOhYed6hNVgkRV3x09BmHYXJw70bxRVVe8llcVSgv3SAvmhAearKQ2fQM8xJHdchysMffHI9Gvi5UzZGE_S6TEnfmNRJKwaZpFqS75ohboNvQ%3D)_** , and I'm angry and astonished.
**He's talking to Democrats about needing _“_****bodyguards for everybody and civil war conditions**** _”_****after they disqualify President Trump from holding office.**
**_[This might be the most important email I've ever sent you, and everyone who receives this email needs to read exactly what Raskins said](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=89ea8bdfcef641ee8de3a1b1b40a893a&_e=hDefVIFHn4yAqOugcO8PtFJo7DF1SM5G7LVI7RKSPrfi2Gh4UDIuRKp1O9o6p7cg8BsETyF_Mlk2PKa29bCAKqRpFaO0c9qLvHGUJlQncD76dSVYTfuw2siUynQ_kL9S1PhflOqiL1WaK9Dz50YdEm5hBMq0FiGcc2kwpa2_swU5eVj75NdVcpgIqQPMw9u24pNwx7JSzua25l0VtNYZVncRfFoMwUiX0BmfFtiPNLR7X7cqsNIv452EjO5rQsN40vtGFPg8Ch7ZBINHOVr4aNIMg6cK94w0NcEabtsBkH2N3siwV7SzeXRHFaPQF8IWbA8yWqVHIhiU3fdM0EeJlM0WlKPvg8oO9-4wjZVGhdPPfmaAq9k8yevtloL18_bZNw9esf9c_TleKIhmfEPpcEzsPaTUTFXffByioUSBnao%3D)_.**
I've known for a long time that Raskins has Trump Derangement Syndrome, but I never thought he'd plot to destroy our Republic because of it.
There is no question we are in one of America's darkest hours and that evil surrounds us. It can be demoralizing at times, _but we cannot lose sight of why we fight_.
**For our families, our faith, and the last bastion of freedom in the world; the United States of America.**
I refuse to cower in fear and I will not waver in my fight to save the country I love.
**_[I hope you're ready to join us, there's no more time to sit on the sidelines](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=89ea8bdfcef641ee8de3a1b1b40a893a&_e=hDefVIFHn4yAqOugcO8PtFJo7DF1SM5G7LVI7RKSPrfi2Gh4UDIuRKp1O9o6p7cg8BsETyF_Mlk2PKa29bCAKqRpFaO0c9qLvHGUJlQncD76dSVYTfuw2siUynQ_kL9S1PhflOqiL1WaK9Dz50YdEm5hBMq0FiGcc2kwpa2_swU5eVj75NdVcpgIqQPMw9u24pNwx7JSzua25l0VtNYZVncRfFoMwUiX0BmfFtiPNLR7X7cqsNIv452EjO5rQsN40vtGFPg8Ch7ZBINHOVr4aONg7ElHTqeolSJsbSRplTKEBhPB8pKAOJVARnVthKAOkgl2eiQ0Rc3jlYFniYa2S1jBzPmBl3Esoc78Hn8iatiYQAhE9k1mGAjkrUHY5iR0DYbx3WOCiHIJS1MuIoLv6xwct4w2EV9D6m6DdMWGrQI%3D)_.**
With Courage,

James Comer Chairman, House Oversight Committee

Team: First, Opponents of voting rights gerrymandered Wisconsin. Then they lost critical elections for Governor and State Supreme Court. Then they tried to fire the nonpartisan Wisconsin Elections Commission Administrator. Now they want to abolish the commission and give it's power to themselves to run their partisan agenda.
The Elections Administrator -- who " has been the subject of conspiracy theories and threats from election skeptics who falsely claim she was part of a plan to rig the 2020 vote in Wisconsin " -- has refused to give in to lies about how elections are run in Wisconsin. So the vote suppressors in the Wisconsin legislature just introduced a bill that would abolish the Wisconsin Elections Commission entirely and grant more power over elections to the state's Republican-controlled Legislature.
These state legislators are clearly obsessed with protecting their own power and will seemingly stop at nothing to stay in control of the most gerrymandered state in the country. This bill raises huge concerns about how this critical state -- where the margin of victory in the last presidential election came down to less than a percentage point -- will conduct the 2024 election.

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. clean_body: To build real power, it takes all of us to consistently engage. | | | Peter, With just 83 days until Election Day, it’s crucial that we remain grounded in community, hope, clarity, and our movement’s power. On Wednesday's call, we'll get the opportunity to join in conversation with Abbas Alawieh and Layla Elabed of the Uncommitted National Movement. Uncommitted has registered and mobilized people of conscience to civically engage in this election around an anti-war agenda that specifically calls for an immediate and permanent ceasefire, an arms embargo, an end to the long-term siege on Gaza. They are using their platform to push voters to engage in November in a meaningful way to fight fascism and strengthen our democracy. We are united in our joint call for a ceasefire and an economy that puts working people first. We'll have the opportunity to deepen our understanding of the strategy to block far-right extremism and build progressive governing power. To build real power, it takes all of us to consistently engage. And to harness that energy, we'll need to engage with people who are currently on the fence about voting for Kamala Harris for president. With our endorsement of VP Harris' candidacy and her announcement of Tim Walz as her running mate, there has been a new excitement in the air around this presidential election. That energy brings new opportunities to strengthen the broad coalition of people across race, age, and identity that will help to defeat Donald Trump and his MAGA movement. **New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations,

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9kb20lus1mhccpk5t5eal97ecq1p026vi51b5f8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdh69or5c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we’ve seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoe8osaa2pts4h2d2h2ndkk06p4csb4nhsuia4mo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdh69or5c9h2bs)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zq7kncjv0b8846oif1695ijm7gfic08rsng7fpa8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdh69or5c9h2bs)**[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zslfmopnf270cfitfihoqtnhq9cqnsu4d4vvaqf8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdh69or5c9h2bs), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers—one from each scholar—written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6rgfoicqf8ek1a37bop5s8399tt9ml8qbaavhb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdh69or5c9h2bs)** Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University
---
_With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred years, Hoover’s work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, the
Biden/Harris Administration, and the Big Labor bosses are about
to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to launch the next, crucial phase
for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, the Biden/Harris Administration, and Big Labor
to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $100, $200, and
even more. For others, a contribution of $25 or $50 has been as
much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $200, $100,
$50, $25, or $15, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then pitch in with your
contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to the National
Right to Work Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25,
or $15 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://trk.secureandprosper._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1TUE81MzMxNiJ9/GFsiBUx256lVoG_JVk9NUg)

We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.

| Greater Georgia Newsletter August 14, 2024
We're just 83 days from Election Day, and so much has happened over the last few months. But one thing remains the same: Greater Georgia is working tirelessly to grow and defend the conservative movement in our state.
Over the summer, we've focused on diverse community outreach and building a grassroots army of election integrity watchdogs to serve as poll workers and watchers this November. With less than three months to go until Election Day, we're preparing to launch several additional campaigns - including efforts to register last-minute voters, highlight the failures of liberal politicians, and traditional get-out-the-vote and absentee ballot chase programs.
If you haven't signed up to volunteer yet, now is the time to get involved! Our team has millions of voters on our target list - and we need your help to reach them and share the conservative message. Volunteer deployments are beginning NOW - so please consider signing up to help by clicking [HERE](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001buD3jqsAzpwFHbXEAY8xVl6l0FGFxyNg8ezicLNt9mvv0Z6TwUQi7N20PnGSVO-G2RdGGt-qha9ZuOLAvoSmk7CdtGCDcU58Wdhh6vcpt5cyeZIppGCC3ho9mMrAajucFkyKiFS1KTTnIXWdPnjBgh5YtieVEaxdIkRB8oa_rzM=&c=L2EZaDmwO4DJKUrbVeF7IuMVrb7pGvji6--77XK6CXATXMbj-5TGUA==&ch=8rmMTw-YCDd4PccLY7Njwzdhq8y3VXYUmEkRgHas1LXqn5oUY3iVBw==).

| Two weeks ago, Greater Georgia announced a six-figure campaign to mobilize diverse communities ahead of the 2024 election. We plan to use a combination of digital ads, text messages, phone calls, and direct mail to reach a targeted universe of Black, Hispanic, and Asian voters in key counties across Georgia. The six-figure campaign will highlight how the liberal policies in Washington have failed Georgians on the economy, crime, immigration, foreign policy, and other kitchen-table issues. clean_body: | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter August 14, 2024 We're just 83 days from Election Day, and so much has happened over the last few months. But one thing remains the same: Greater Georgia is working tirelessly to grow and defend the conservative movement in our state. Over the summer, we've focused on diverse community outreach and building a grassroots army of election integrity watchdogs to serve as poll workers and watchers this November. With less than three months to go until Election Day, we're preparing to launch several additional campaigns - including efforts to register last-minute voters, highlight the failures of liberal politicians, and traditional get-out-the-vote and absentee ballot chase programs. If you haven't signed up to volunteer yet, now is the time to get involved! Our team has millions of voters on our target list - and we need your help to reach them and share the conservative message. Volunteer deployments are beginning NOW - so please consider signing up to help by clicking ==. | | | LATEST NEWS | == | Two weeks ago, Greater Georgia announced a six-figure campaign to mobilize diverse communities ahead of the 2024 election. We plan to use a combination of digital ads, text messages, phone calls, and direct mail to reach a targeted universe of Black, Hispanic, and Asian voters in key counties across Georgia. The six-figure campaign will highlight how the liberal policies in Washington have failed Georgians on the economy, crime, immigration, foreign policy, and other kitchen-table issues. Read more about the latest effort ==. | | | RECENT COVERAGE | == | Last week, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler joined radio host Erick Erickson at the 2024 Gathering Conference - where they discussed the lessons of 2020, the year-round infrastructure that Greater Georgia has built to avoid a repeat, how everyday citizens can get involved to keep their elections safe, and many other topics of the day - from the farm to the economy. Click == or on the image above to listen to her full interview. | == | While at the RNC Convention, Chairwoman Loeffler also joined Breitbart News for a sit-down conversation. In it, she contrasted the successes of conservative policy with the dangerous agenda of the far left on the economy, energy, national security, education, and public safety. Her message was clear: the path to the presidency runs through Georgia, which is why we must continue working to share the conservative message. Click == or on the image above to watch the interview. | == | Chairwoman Loeffler also sat down last month for a long-form interview featured on "The Georgia Vote" show on 11 Alive. She discussed Greater Georgia, the stakes of the 2024 election, her sense of how voters are feeling on the ground, and why every conservative must work together to win in November. Click == or on the image above to watch the full interview. | == | == | == | From Atlanta to Milwaukee to Washington, Chairwoman Loeffler has done more than two dozen interviews in the last few weeks. You can catch some of her other recent hits on ==, ==, ==, == ==, the ==, the ==, the ==, the ==, and the ==! | | | EVENTS Trump 47 Poll Watcher Training in Gwinnett County August 8, 2024 Chairwoman Loeffler joined the Trump 47 team last week in Gwinnett County for a poll watcher training session. Over 150 patriots attended the event, where they signed up to become poll watchers and learned how their involvement as the front lines of election integrity defenders helps keep our elections safe and secure. If you want to sign up to become a poll watcher this year, please click ==. | | | | Supermercado Voter Registration Drive in Fulton County August 3, 2024 Earlier this month, Greater Georgia held a native-language voter registration drive in Roswell at a local supermercado. Our interns and volunteers spoke with dozens of Georgians - many of whom were grateful for the opportunity to discuss the issues and policies that mattered most to their families. | | | Roundtable With Black Pastors and Leaders July 23, 2024 In July, Pastor Dwayne Hardin hosted Greater Georgia for a roundtable with black pastors and leaders at The Embassy ATL. The group discussed the power of faith, opportunity, and freedom, as well as how courage and the conservative movement can preserve those crucial aspects of life for all Georgians. America is truly one nation under God! | | Republican National Convention in Milwaukee July 16, 2024 Chairwoman Loeffler was thrilled to attend the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee last month. She spent some time with President Trump and Senator Vance, dropped in to greet Georgia's delegation, joined several news programs, and enjoyed an optimistic, unifying week that was dedicated to the forgotten men and women of America. | | | Cobb County GOP Fourth of July BBQ July 4, 2024 Greater Georgia celebrated our nation's independence by joining the Cobb County GOP at its Fourth of July BBQ. There was massive energy on the ground as a number of patriots commemorated the day by registering to vote and volunteer. | | | | | INTERNSHIP PROGRAM Just last week, we said goodbye to our outstanding group of summer interns. I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z362tuqus4kht2k2nakhnn1oatq2j0hf8vk02mfg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0ascf94s5901cadr70v0anqir0kkkbgtjdbl9d8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z49644nv0t59su8seuhv4ml36l6qvj1n39dfgq00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmoq07q7om3uki9963dhroe5rdimqptp09elo73o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhua5ilpf3t2gsn6gtnbpa5q7rh585qlum76144o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)_**

Thank you and may God bless you,
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsllqvf6aiesm75ok3jvgk5ccr7cq5l5dpjud93g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cdj61or6c3h2bs)

PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I only ask that you please say a prayer for everyone currently serving in harm’s way.

And, while Kamala and Tim refuse to answer questions from the press or lay-out any of their policy agenda, we at the Republican Party of Wisconsin will be here for the next 87 days to remind the American people what these two truly stand for.
---

On August 13, Wisconsin voters will have the opportunity to have their voices heard on two possible amendments to the Wisconsin Constitution. Referendum Question 1 asks if voters would be in favor of adding an amendment that prohibits the Executive Branch from delegating its power to appropriate money to projects of their choice; referendum Question 2 will change the Constitution to require the governor earn legislative approval before spending federal dollars given to the state. Both former Governor Scott Walker and former Governor Tommy Thompson have [urged voters ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mitmtd-didthutlhu-f/)to say "YES" to Questions 1 and 2. Voting 'yes' on these initiatives will restore transparency and honesty to government spending, prohibiting Governor Tony Evers from using Wisconsinites hard-earned tax dollars to support his far-left agenda! This just in! Kamala Harris has finally released her first policy proposal: no tax on tips! If that sounds familiar to you, that's because Donald Trump [initiated](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mitmtd-didthutlhu-z/) initiated this legislative reform on June 9. The Harris Campaign can roll out Tik Toks, but it seems as if they are having a difficult time establishing a sound policy vision for the administration itself. We'll see if Kamala sticks to this idea, or flip-flops like she has on every other one of her policy positions.

## FBI Probes Hack Attacks on Both Campaigns
The FBI announced that it has [opened an investigation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFuhDAQAF9jOiN7WQxXuEhDd2lTImMW2MQYhH0gfh9d6tSjkUbz9eyfjgPH-dOtZPO09c5nPqlvpUYJ2GMx2okIqCrI6gYqg4BaFYsdRmweuqZ2MIOehso1Ta316AEQfaXqgi0oQNVq1EoZZcq3qAFqQKOg1a1ARSPn7Si_N455oSnc20lH6be1CHbJeU-i-hDQCeiu6yrj4CNd6c0FdJn8IqBL5F8H51tANw0sk7uTTJLjSSnz7DLHWebjte7Su3V3PEfpg-NVLs7_0CgnDpTk4aPTxuhHUxx23C8OgZNpBKp5dRz-kvL_g04LvwEAAP__iMxoXQ) into attempted hacks of both presidential campaigns.The investigation focuses on cyber-attacks against three Biden-Harris campaign staffers and Roger Stone, a former adviser to former President Trump.The announcement followed [a previous statement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FurDAQRb_G7haNh7GBwsVr6Pa1KZExwzKRwSuwQMnXR6ROd6Wrc6Tz8RyeQZJsr_9hZV_mPIRY5OShfRh6IA2kJz8zI9eavWmwdoRkQC--Q-tqYIw4htEx2HmuO9e1lk1DZrJaPAIStIYMgANX3aBBtEgOsDWtIuBJSt6rzyxbWXhOX_nkvYp51ckvpbwPVf9T2Cvsr-uqxjHen8J-4-tQ2Ie9SEx8z8jd97bbc2PMevfT-5KU5HCNInitQdKvtfzdeHr8CQAA__9tmlGg) released by Microsoft stating the tech company discovered Iranian hackers targeted the campaign of an unnamed U.S. presidential candidate in June.Politico and other media outlets reported on Saturday that they had begun receiving internal [Trump campaign documents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FyrSAQxvGngU5nd-Ugt6C4Dd1Jm9JBDugmKI4Snbx9xtTpv29-839_Dk_PmdfpzS_R1lQGHyqfcTANqobUoOTLphgpdjJa7KnTihSCnO1owoieQhjBp95rHNU_6PGhISVIlCRbAlJgUCGABt3eRyR6kNJABo1QEF9cy95-FF7rHFP-Lmfc21AWme1c63aI7r8gJ8hd19VuJXPlUO6BILfG6xDkbkWQAyPIIQhydf9atib4ZfM8rc3sw2cDgH33gE7u9rVdnDMfuhcKpsVz_gXr3_mnpZ8AAAD__4O0WNM) in July. ## Judge Blocks Release of A-F School Ratings
A Travis County judge [temporarily blocked](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2u4yAQxfGnwR0WjDEfBcU2dNl2S2sM4xgtMZFN4uTtr5L-1kc6-un_7zJdMJe8Xf_ijXx7LXXC2PKTJsul4qAm1SU_i-RkR14aGPRgJUC3euk0WWmkcE4ubgA1iGhtGkk7Nye3dNmDACWsVFKMGoZ-VobQOg1j1AZwYEpQyq3ufVup0QuPpbzrk_Y-1ltX_Nra_WDDHwaBQTjPs_-_1sdnZBBwbzkWYhA2Og8GgdIjYst1YxC-ZxxjrI-t4ZxLbm--Y8vb9eAfFYMAduQYlSCtNacRBFfJSe4QDI9zjEsEJYxaut2n-5lLyYc2TInrDXP5CtsvwZ4efgIAAP__pTlqfw) the release of A-F accountability grades for public schools after a lawsuit from several districts claimed the grades would be based on flawed STAAR test results. Plaintiffs challenged the [use of artificial intelligence](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGSnDAQRL9GZLMFgxa0gQInys6pw62RkGDKQqLQsL77e9de4MxZV1cHr9-vj-cHceay_qQ9WvlM9UlB-BWfBgYNqJ-6W6zvl8fQRTvMOE6jGRC7zZqkk9Hehz74--MeE-HgvSYTHzOlkTq22KPuzaCH_j7hePN6jmQeE97DNCONSvdxYannTbYo8ZNayl_1Fc9bqHuX7SZyNDX-UOgUulD3_SosX7wfFOS9UejoasJFoWv1kg1CLHJShn91XK5AwvWd3zgKXW8UumFU6CQS1BIi0EpcwOcafscF0ll34NYuLisQJDhJuKwNUj3hmxOOy2cO0MJWa24KXXfa5fjDOXObZqX7dSfO3z_kP1pfFv8GAAD__xtyfQk) to grade essay responses, arguing Education Commissioner Mike Morath has failed to demonstrate the test is "valid and reliable." Texas Education Agency officials said that the ruling is "[keeping families in the dark](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGzoyAUhX8NdteRK4oWFGncKlvulg7IRXkPJQMkJv_-TdK_6hRnzplvvv_X-ap98Mf6V--kytPFWS_FP2gegAtAMYvKKtPYkVekuMS2bweOWG1KO2MH51rXda4x0orOjKJvOcqRiORYeYUNimbggjddj21thCQ9jD12Sy9Rt0w0ZH2JqS4bFXrq7MIrPijVS9yroLZSbpm1F4YTw-k8z3rPx7tjONEB98xwOuh8RywbJYaTBgdr0pYyuJjgcwp52WIMGUyIyzdZ0Kv2B5gXaPi625XeuwSXC49_1vyvSsreTh-Cz71koll37cOHqPwi6KHwJwAA___B6GkE) about how their schools are doing," citing opposition from some administrators to "fair accountability and transparency." A hearing is scheduled for Monday, Aug. 26.
## San Antonio Carriage Survey Gets Big Response
The City of San Antonio's survey on horse-drawn carriages has received an overwhelming response, with [over 47,000 submissions](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vwyAUAH8N3rDgGX9kYOjClq4drQe8xKgYIqB28u-rdO98w53u67peMcSQ7p-4k27PW17RtXDQunCpOKhVdV5b4S-yIy1nGKZhkQDdph0hjmBx8OPsFi9wseDoZq2TJJz1XdAgQIlFKinGCYbeqplwuUwwumkGHJgS5EPLpW8bNXpivcVXPqj0Lu9d1Ftrj8qGDwaGgTnPs_-u2N6QgUl0VgYmZoeRgXmrGBixMDByYGAqJo6p5RQy33KpxH3BM3GHpQS8E68_5aAXL-QoHFT5jrWGg3ih-sipEgPTFe0fZ4gx1GlmStx3DPEvrv3z6tDwGwAA__8DJW2_) by Monday, the day before it closed. The city council will [consider a complete ban](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGynCAUgOGnwQ4HDiBYUKSxu2lTOgc5rkxY2QGiu2-fSfpb_80_36-v9QtTTufjJz7J9_deVtx6umh1XGoOetVD9EHEWQ7kpQU1KScBhsPvEgJGE0VEEGqKYbcubDQrNNaoyQ3JgwAtnNRSmAnUGLQldPMEZpssoGJaUEy91LEf1OmNbc-fclEdt_Icsj96fzWmfjBYGCz3fY-_6WzmX2WwYO1py8RgOeluDJZcNswMlqPURjxWvE--Ya0JH9R4w5Pj2cuZCm9_6kUffhB2fhP2gyqDBaziQZAxCg3X0VmutUIeZHA8wgxSgtOocag-vu6Uc2qTZVo8npjy_-X-jeDl4W8AAAD__4z1cbc) on the popular attraction at their Aug. 19 meeting, weighing survey results and staff recommendations. Carriage ban advocates cite [traffic issues and animal welfare](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQAL_GdBuZxYApXLyGLq-9Ei14AysRG9k-SP7-lOuvHmk0mq_7dCfZJaz_6cmuvB5xoqXIyZOF2gCayVTezdoPdcWu7rHpGlsjVpsbvNbYPlprNWLvtW_YMtdzY3EeBraVONRotK1NrdsOm9tseiY7dNguXY_UKKPZS4npVjYu_KL82N_x5HRb4rPa3VbKkVXzT-GocNxi9LsE_kCF48etcNRW4ZgpAIUSg0RInMVzKBkulnUDCRADbDFlBp_oCrBQSkIrw0wBLikbJF5i8pC_08lvOCgVWeSgIjEoHKvk_HHJvkvuemX0-iTZfxPLH8dOhz8BAAD__1HNb34), while operators question the survey's fairness and validity.

The movie adaptation of "It Ends With Us," based on East Texas native Colleen Hoover's 2016 romance novel, has earned [$80 million worldwide](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGypCAQheGnwawtaBAxINjE7G66odVCe4dalCmhdPbtt2by-wJfnfP_-Vq-KOV0fP-mnX17bWWh0NLFiwNlAM1iuuhXGSfVsVcjaqudQuwePsgQmYw120Da8cTasY0SHfG4rU53yaNEI50ySg4Wdb-akclNFodgRyQtjOSYWjn79uDGL6pb_lcuPvtQ9i77R2vPKvQvgbPA-b7vPqxVTX27BM50thQyC5wPvqvAOZdAWeC8lysxpKM-08kRmGqDDw4HvZ9VWEv5C0znUcFJ2FPOqRxwlzPHO8U3OUgFhNpOSmmQFBwYDAGINws8hJXXYKOM2J0-Pu83UO0ojPzeKeXP-vZDzMvj_wAAAP__EtZ2oA) in its opening weekend after its release on Friday. The film, which stars [Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFugzAQQL_G3ozss2Ng8NCFLV07ogs-B0sGInyB5O-rZu_-9J70fq7jFXPJ6_0bFwr8StuIE-eDxk4Zp8CNTsZw07E3koJpwXrbGQA5hxbI2653FwMuxT7qZCZ_85NLFm3qk8wBNDjdGWf0xYNtbq4l7HoPl8m3gFY4TTHztjc8E9MLayrv7aC9mbZFljAzP6qwXwIGAcN5ns2BpdB7opV3LH-UgGGlswoYMitaY1Vn5lk9q8Inz9uujlwzV0VYWX0SimdCpl3AIPcQH2cuJVffCqfvC-aPVfI_K44AvwEAAP__QpZi5w), secured second place at the box office behind "Deadpool and Wolverine." Named one of [TIME's 100 Most Influential People](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQxvGnwRsRHBjDwNCFLV07WgQu8UnYWPE1Td--SqWOnT99-kn_j_N8ztRou73nFSM_r33OhemBs5faSrCzHWq8qBr0gFFPYJzxGmBY4liDLaNWoU6QEYy7gCre59FYMwWvB4qgwCqvrVajA3O62AmzDw7G4ibIRliFlbjfT7wg4zMf1_bdH3g_lb4OLS7M-yHMm4AkIDGt-BoEpNJbw8LUNwFJKyXXfrCk7do-cWPKTe7Y94YSFBgByYHzwcPfEze59JcjIA33WPcvao0ONwmrbmum9uvzPzkeEX4CAAD__-M3X-8) in 2023, Hoover's meteoric rise to fame was largely fueled by TikTok's book-loving community, #BookTok.

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66d7c0f914aa4040a2655eab65e30a85&_e=GkrfxcYvwfVUMuIrgkKIPX6C8TXHg6aOqoVdgzofZmlLVmdVCWZa8ls_lEjltwYjXQcHW6ZGj5_xWrm92SAmLD4xa9s8XK5EJJvdAcO_wxelhLQT9N2xvHToY13bDKN6gUOyNNS93-H6PifqE-HQHCEPIomQ4xu7uv7DlmKhymwhNXV-MAs_4TrjVix1WogyCmtvftBq04hygoGEK1uYtQE_WeCfOry2Xc-N_dWek_Q8UpreZm6sor8Ro2SeTWFM4ZtG1W47_3Ooyy1RQnk3qBd42IUh2782B5OWcGd2lzbijyTaP3p5yg-jJJw6pim_)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.

clean_body: I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well. | | | | | Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me. I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind. Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream. When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into. But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life. Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable. I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies. My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation. We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility. That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs. President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support. My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part. I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation. If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST. Thank you and may God bless you, JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I'd like to invite you to join Rocky Mountain Voice at the United Community Leaders of Colorado Mid-Year Meeting and Awards Ceremony this Saturday, August 17th! They will be also be honoring common sense legislators, community leaders, and individuals who have demonstrated a commitment to defending life, faith, family and freedom in Colorado. This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, August 14, 2024.

**[Advance Colorado could pull two ballot initiatives, likely leading to property-tax special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE SUM & SUBSTANCE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado legislators appear headed for another debate about lowering property taxes after an influential commission largely backed a compromise plan Monday to cut taxes further if backers of two wide-ranging initiatives removed the measures from the November ballot.
It’s not an absolute certainty that Gov. Jared Polis would call a special session to consider the framework deal agreed to by initiative proponents Colorado Concern and Advance Colorado with legislators and other officials who have been involved in negotiations. But with Polis having signaled a willingness to consider the idea and with the governor-backed Commission on Property Tax getting some level of support from most of its members to the general details in the plan, pressure is building to avoid a pricey ballot battle.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Faulting new law, after daughter transitions to boy, parents sue Colorado, Brighton school district](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A couple in Brighton, Colorado, is suing the state and the local school district, claiming a law that facilitates transgender identity in schools violates their parental rights by allowing their daughter to secretly transition to male.
* The lawsuit targets House Bill 1039, which requires schools to use a student's preferred name and opens them to discrimination claims for non-compliance, asserting it is unconstitutional.
* The parents allege the school district and a counselor facilitated their daughter's transition without their knowledge, using state-provided virtual therapy sessions to conceal this from them.
* They claim this unauthorized transition damaged their relationship with their daughter, who has since begun to detransition and regrets her initial decision.
* The lawsuit seeks to enforce parental notification or consent for social transitions in schools, citing potential harm to children and parent-child relationships.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Number of new Colorado businesses drops 21.7% nearly a year after filing-fee discount ends](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado saw a 21.7% drop in new business filings in the second quarter, largely due to the end of a reduced $1 filing fee program, reverting fees to $50.
* Despite the decline, overall businesses in good standing increased to 963,373, though delinquencies in filings also rose by nearly 91,000.
* Business registration fees have increased to fund county election reimbursements, due to lack of designated state budget funds.
* Economic indicators are mixed, with some growth in jobs and GDP, but increased credit delinquencies and reduced consumer credit use.
* University of Colorado economists do not foresee a U.S. recession, noting moderate inflation and steady, if slow, economic and employment growth.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘I’m opposed to the timing’: Former Denver Mayor Wellington Webb pushes back on tax initiative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former Denver Mayor Wellington Webb opposes a new affordable housing tax proposed by current Mayor Mike Johnston, citing conflict with a necessary tax increase for Denver Health.
* Webb stresses that the Denver Health tax, aimed at supporting the hospital's critical services and $136 million in uncompensated care, should be prioritized due to its importance as a trauma and teaching center.
* The proposed housing tax would be Denver's eighth dedicated tax, potentially raising the city's sales tax to nearly 10%, comparable to major cities like Los Angeles and New York.
* Johnston's office counters by emphasizing the urgency of addressing affordable housing, alongside supporting Denver Health, to tackle the city's broader crises effectively.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Tina Peters hints at appeal in aftermath of election security conviction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters was convicted on seven charges related to the breach of the county's election system but hinted at appealing the verdict.
* Peters faced charges including three felony counts of attempting to influence a public official and was acquitted on three other counts; she could face a minimum of six years to over 20 years in prison depending on how her sentences are served.
* In response to her conviction, Peters expressed disappointment on social media, suggesting the trial was unfair and promising to continue fighting for what she believes is the truth.
* High-profile figures like Mike Lindell and Roger Stone publicly supported Peters, with Stone comparing her trial to his own, claiming she was not allowed to adequately defend herself.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[‘J6 Praying Grandma’ avoids prison, will be on house arrest with ankle monitor for six months](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rebecca Lavrenz, known as the "J6 Praying Grandma," was sentenced to one year of probation and six months of house arrest without prison time for her involvement in the Capitol breach on January 6, 2021.
* Lavrenz was convicted of four misdemeanor charges but avoided prison, instead receiving a $103,000 fine, largely funded by public donations which totaled about $166,000. She is also restricted from internet use and cannot engage in social media or other digital activities as part of her sentence.
* Lavrenz plans to appeal the conviction, with her legal fees already amounting to $130,000 and expected to increase significantly.
* Lavrenz expressed her motivations as driven by her religious beliefs and desire to assert her First Amendment rights, maintaining she did not participate in any violence during the event.

**[Memo: There is ‘no question’ Kamala Harris was tasked with serving as ‘Border Czar’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A memo from Advancing American Freedom sent to all U.S. lawmakers criticizes Vice President Kamala Harris for failing to secure the border, despite being tasked with managing diplomatic efforts with Central America.
* The memo highlights that under Harris's watch, there have been over 8 million illegal border encounters, and illegal immigration is costing billions in welfare and education annually.
* It also cites specific violent crimes committed by illegal immigrants to underline the perceived security failures of the Biden-Harris administration.

**[Hardin: The relevance of the 2nd Amendment today](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The 2nd Amendment to the United States Constitution, part of the Bill of Rights ratified in 1791, states: “A well-regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.”_
_This short, but potent, sentence has generated extensive debate through the years, reflecting evolving societal values, legal interpretations and practical implications. Let’s explore the relevance of the 2nd Amendment in contemporary America._
_Initially, the 2nd Amendment was framed in the context of an emerging nation wary of standing armies and oppressive governments. The “militia” referred to ordinary citizens ready to defend their communities. The framers of the 2nd Amendment intended to ensure that citizens could protect themselves from external threats and potential government tyranny, being a situation where a government exercises power in a cruel, oppressive or unjust manner. It involves the abuse of authority by those in power, often resulting in the suppression of individual freedoms and rights._

This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, August 14, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES Colorado legislators appear headed for another debate about lowering property taxes after an influential commission largely backed a compromise plan Monday to cut taxes further if backers of two wide-ranging initiatives removed the measures from the November ballot. It’s not an absolute certainty that Gov. Jared Polis would call a special session to consider the framework deal agreed to by initiative proponents Colorado Concern and Advance Colorado with legislators and other officials who have been involved in negotiations. The lawsuit targets House Bill 1039, which requires schools to use a student's preferred name and opens them to discrimination claims for non-compliance, asserting it is unconstitutional. The parents allege the school district and a counselor facilitated their daughter's transition without their knowledge, using state-provided virtual therapy sessions to conceal this from them. If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my mid-month goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. tomorrow to help me continue our fight for progress this year? Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve. There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory. Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. Missing my mid-month goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you again for all that you do. I'm so grateful to have you on my team in this critical election year. With love, Kirsten | | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

name: Sienna Gonzales
subject: What a clean energy future means to me
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
I created this for Evergreen supporters like you
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2768122/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi friend,

My name is Sienna Gonzales. I'm a queer Mexican and Chitimachan artist based in Los Angeles.

**I want to tell you a story.**

When Evergreen asked me to design this poster to illustrate one of four pillars of their core vision—one that centers a **thriving, just, inclusive clean energy future** —I started brainstorming my own vision of what that means to me. |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2768123/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| As an artist, **a clear vision is foundational to my creative process.**

I often begin with curating a mood board, gathering images that resonate with the colors, atmosphere, and composition of the piece I envision, which helps me set the tone of the work.

Following this, I engage in a brief creative writing exercise to describe the image I aim to create, which solidifies the emotional impact I want the viewer to experience.

Only after I establish this vision do I begin sketching—starting with broad, loose shapes to establish the composition. Gradually, I refine these sketches, bringing the piece into more and more focus.

When I heard about the **Evergreen Action Plan 2.0** , it felt like this monumental effort was also grounded in **a clear vision** , brought to life by thoughtful steps and refinements along the way.

And I was moved by the plan's commitment to helping our leaders build, piece-by-piece, the better, brighter future we all want and deserve.

**If you resonate with this vision like I do,**[**I hope you'll start a monthly donation of just $15 to support Evergreen's work.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2768124/87SdQ4wZ) If you do, you'll get a free gift from Evergreen in return—one of four posters (including my own!) that illustrate a future that’s clean, thriving, just, and inclusive. |
---
[START A MONTHLY GIFT TO EVERGREEN](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2768125/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| As someone who believes that optimism is a powerful force—one that not only captures attention but also inspires action—designing this poster was an incredibly meaningful experience for me. **A clean energy future embodies a collective commitment to the well-being of both people and the planet** , and it's an honor to think that my work might play a role in bringing us closer to that shared goal.

For a brighter future, |
---
| | |
---
### Sienna Gonzales
Artist & Illustrator
---
---
|
* * *
**P.S.** The other works in the poster series are _stunning._ [**If you start a recurring gift of $40 or more each month, you’ll automatically get all four as a gift!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2768126/87SdQ4wZ) |

subject: Crucial New York Case Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY
body:
The Democratic Party has become the biggest threat to democracy in this country.

|

| | | | [**The Democratic Party has become the biggest threat to democracy in this country.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=1)

[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=3)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=4)
---
|
---
Dear Peter,
People have been asking about the New York case to remove me from the ballot, so let me tell you what it means.
[I’ll still be on the ballot, don’t worry about that. We will appeal this decision and win. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=5)
The worry here isn’t about my campaign for President. The worry is about the state of our country. **Basically what this case says is, “We don’t want you to choose.”**
Our campaign took on the 45,000 ballot signature requirement in New York and blew it out of the water. We collected over 135,000 signatures – more than any candidate in history.
But instead of bending to the will of the people, the DNC went behind their back to invalidate their choice.
Did you know that Iran and China have elections? Even the Soviet Union had them. **But you could only vote for state-approved candidates._Well, it’s turning into that here too_.**
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
We have Kamala Harris – the hand-picked candidate of DNC insiders – now their presidential nominee without having received a single vote. But I’m not an approved candidate, so they’re trying to remove me from the ballot.
[The Democratic Party is trying to silence your voice and restrict your choice in our democracy. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=6)
[They are weaponizing the courts to take away your right to vote for the candidate you like best and choose the kind of America you want to live in. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=7)
**They don’t believe in democracy or trust the voters anymore.** They think they are entitled to choose who you are allowed to vote for. They think they should be the judge of what is best for you and your family.
That says something about the DNC’s contempt for democracy. Instead of fighting for voters’ rights, the DNC has a multi-million dollar army of lawyers devoted to reducing your choices at the ballot box.
**Are you going to stand by and let that happen?**
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=8)
---
[The Democratic Party has become the biggest threat to democracy in this country. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=9)
The party that once stood for working people has abandoned them to Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and the endless war machine.
I have a theory about what is behind the Democrats' transformation. **_It's fear_.**
**Democracy terrifies them because they are corrupt.** It terrifies them because they are addicted to power. It terrifies them because they are obsessed with control.
They want to control what we read on the internet. They want to control our medical decisions. And they want to control who we are allowed to vote for.
We have a perfect record of defeating DNC challenges. A court of appeals will reverse this decision, but the usurping of democracy won’t be reversed unless YOU reverse it, because democracy means rule of the people, and YOU are the people.
I will do my part too. My part is to make sure that you have the choice that the establishment wants to take away from you. **But I can't do it alone.**
[I need your support now to win this fight and get elected.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=10) Donate today to help us take on the establishment and secure victory in November.
| [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?amount=50&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=11)
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?amount=75&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_rsnd1&n=12)

---
**I promise you, I will never bend to the bullying. I will fight for our country every step of the way to November 5th.**
And you will have an authentic choice of a truly independent candidate on Election Day.
| |

Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

The worry here isn’t about my campaign for President. The worry is about the state of our country. Basically what this case says is, “We don’t want you to choose.” Our campaign took on the 45,000 ballot signature requirement in New York and blew it out of the water. We collected over 135,000 signatures – more than any candidate in history. But instead of bending to the will of the people, the DNC went behind their back to invalidate their choice. Did you know that Iran and China have elections? Even the Soviet Union had them. But you could only vote for state-approved candidates.Well, it’s turning into that here too. As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America. We have Kamala Harris – the hand-picked candidate of DNC insiders – now their presidential nominee without having received a single vote. But I’m not an approved candidate, so they’re trying to remove me from the ballot. They don’t believe in democracy or trust the voters anymore. They think they are entitled to choose who you are allowed to vote for. They think they should be the judge of what is best for you and your family. That says something about the DNC’s contempt for democracy. Instead of fighting for voters’ rights, the DNC has a multi-million dollar army of lawyers devoted to reducing your choices at the ballot box. Are you going to stand by and let that happen? The party that once stood for working people has abandoned them to Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and the endless war machine. I have a theory about what is behind the Democrats' transformation. It's fear. Democracy terrifies them because they are corrupt. It terrifies them because they are addicted to power. It terrifies them because they are obsessed with control. They want to control what we read on the internet. They want to control our medical decisions. And they want to control who we are allowed to vote for. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

As you may know, the upcoming Senate race in New Mexico is paramount to Republicans. Securing this seat is crucial for a new GOP Senate majority that will be strong enough to deliver results for the American people. Nella Domenici is the candidate who can lead us to victory. Nella is a successful businesswoman and a principled fighter who has put this seat in play in 2024—something the Democrats never expected. This is our chance, friend, to tip the scales in our favor and provide a much-needed check on the radical left’s extreme agenda and President Joe Biden’s unchecked power. Crime is through the roof, over 10 million illegal aliens have flooded our border since Joe Biden became president, and inflation is crushing lower and middle-class families. Americans are suffering under their extreme and oppressive agenda,and I’ve had enough. This race is not just about New Mexico; it’s about the future of our country. We cannot afford to let the radical left run rampant with their destructive policies any longer. She’s a strong, principled fighter that I would be honored to have working alongside me in the Senate. But I need your help to get her there first. So please, don’t wait. Your support NOW is critical to our fight to save America. Thank you for your support. Senator Ron Johnson | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
I am truly honored to have the opportunity to continue to serve the people of the 5th district in Congress
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1329%2E791427%2Eo8if4a)

Friends,
The results are final in Minnesota, and I am truly honored to have the opportunity to continue to serve the people of the 5th district in Congress.
Last night's primary victory would not have been possible without the incredible support of people like you. Thank you.
As a little girl, huddled in a refugee camp and displaced by a civil war, I just wanted to make it out alive. I never could have imagined that one day I would have the privilege of representing the community that welcomed me with open arms in Congress.
It has truly been beyond my wildest dreams. And with this victory, we have shown that Minnesota doesn't just welcome refugees — **_we send them back to Congress.**_
I am grateful to every single person who made this possible.
I want to thank the love of my life, my husband Tim. I want to thank our beautiful kids Isra, Adnan, William, and Ilwad, who motivate me every single day to build a brighter world.
I want to thank my entire team who worked tirelessly to ensure we prevailed yesterday. To all my staff, this work would not be possible without you.
To the volunteers who knocked on doors and made calls all across the 5th district, this victory is yours. I want you to know how proud I am of the work you've done, and of the work we've done together.
Over the past five years, we have changed the arc of what is possible.
We fed 30 million kids during the pandemic.
We started a movement that has canceled student debt for 5 million people in this country.
We passed the most ambitious climate bill in history.
We shifted the national conversation on so many issues, from calling out the horrific genocide in Gaza, to ending subsidies for fossil fuel companies, to tacking the housing affordability crisis.
We've helped thousands of constituents here in Minnesota with issues big and small.
We hosted over a hundred town halls and roundtables — far more than almost any other member of Congress.
We brought home $54 million for projects that are going to change the lives of countless Minnesotans for generations to come.
The work we have done together has been life-changing for so many across our district — **and we are still just getting started.**
I always say that you get what you organize for, and last night, we proved that together.
We proved that organized people will beat organized money.
We showed the right-wing special interests and dark money groups that Minnesota's 5th district is not for sale.
We chose hope. We chose joy. We chose a future where _anything_ is possible.
I have never once taken for granted the trust that you have placed in me. I promise that I will always have your back, just as you have had mine.
I truly cannot wait to see all that we will accomplish together in the next two years and beyond.
Thank you so much.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

**This victory has shown that when we're in the fight together, there is absolutely NOTHING that we can't accomplish.**
**But as Ilhan said, our progressive movement's work is just getting started. Work that none of us — not Ilhan or anyone else — can do alone.**
