_**Right now, we’re genuinely the underdogs. According to the most recently released public poll, this race is tied. That’s why I had the honor of welcoming the President to Montana Friday evening. He’s all-in for Montana, and we’re all-in for him.**_

Peter,

First, I want to thank everyone who donated to my campaign before President Trump’s visit on Friday. Over the week, we hit our goal of raising $50,000 ahead of my sit-down with President Trump and NRSC Chairman Steve Daines.

Hitting goals this close to Election Day is critical, but hitting this goal was more important than most because President Trump spent his valuable time attending a campaign event for me in a state he’s sure to win when he could have been campaigning elsewhere. **_[President Trump showed up for me on Friday evening because he knows how important my race is.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1e614d0348d743ffb7cddc5a98b2ee2d&_e=R0EqvhngbMRXECa4P-9LhXlwXj2jMy1y2JFhC2HXwBiRiPIlq3btCQrQT9ELDK7XaRYdm9hDCMmPhpKKezgiIym7qSc0IwacZ_lMxH1zT8W0SOAoaltzVJJWAdswTMXQ6Gr4hHaOKW7nXl4mqsef5lM9LUXIqMnXB4wTQ27JPXMQGuHcsn7-KQYxWE0afwSpAsbF88Ul5GtGa_Ca6_l56R9TWE7DALYSfhQMjHDN72oKkrYmALu-A7rgSjBvEbbfvLFQ0AvkPuoEAV2ZraCjJkONjNb_bZ8TmmZDoR1BLegwzt4rNpnGDgHxIy61iZ-O286VC-wPnDe5sK6j6gvdhTHG7ah9e9tOomODVE6AWtt2R2cjHVUJdFRPKNxwmLPfIoSBCV2eiX9kgS-2Az80WSjyfsjMTLdrixa-zf9FErc%3D)_**

President Trump is a lock to win Montana’s electoral votes, **but the Senate race between me and Jon Tester is another story altogether.**

When Trump wins the White House, not having a Republican Senate majority will hamstring his efforts. _**My opponent and his allies know this, which is why they’re spending $120 million to turn out their supporters and tear me down.**_

I’ll cut to the chase: **[I need your financial support to help me reach the 5% of undecided voters in Montana before my opponent.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1e614d0348d743ffb7cddc5a98b2ee2d&_e=R0EqvhngbMRXECa4P-9LhXlwXj2jMy1y2JFhC2HXwBiRiPIlq3btCQrQT9ELDK7XaRYdm9hDCMmPhpKKezgiIym7qSc0IwacZ_lMxH1zT8W0SOAoaltzVJJWAdswTMXQ6Gr4hHaOKW7nXl4mqsef5lM9LUXIqMnXB4wTQ27JPXMQGuHcsn7-KQYxWE0afwSpAsbF88Ul5GtGa_Ca6_l56R9TWE7DALYSfhQMjHDN72oKkrYmALu-A7rgSjBvEbbfvLFQ0AvkPuoEAV2ZraCjJs2OCon1PsySAGzByVPCnoUEGC7qLuRA66bbfLutQ4Q4Olxp9hAtNuNCKFGyNk788Y38NrkHEoMLsD3slAe0lG1XsnqCMvaZsHwywmeHr_HDEHk-mouI90nnv7nZlAd4mhS0obGMaq4AZVJ7fbNGmMA%3D) **

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1775%2E135344%2EE10vVD)

Friend -
Like many of you, I've witnessed (firsthand) the energy out there for Kamala Harris since Joe Biden did the patriotic thing and decided not to run for re-election.
I joined her for an enormous rally in Michigan where the enthusiasm was off the charts (and trust me, it wasn’t fake or AI-generated). I've also seen the polls that showed Joe Biden down in Michigan do an about-face and now show Kamala Harris with a small lead.
So what does that mean for our race?
It's a double-edged sword. First, it's obviously good for us (and America) when the Democratic nominee for president does better. The more votes she gets, the more votes I get. We help each other greatly in the effort to keep Michigan blue, specifically with voter turnout.
But at the same time, Republicans who may have seen Trump's leads in Michigan and focused their energy on other states, now have a renewed focus here.
Because there is absolutely no winning the White House without winning Michigan. That means increased spending, more negative ads, and more Republican efforts to get out their voters before and on Election Day.
That also means we have to raise a bit more money than we might have otherwise.
And there is no meeting our budgets without an increase in grassroots support. That can only come from people like you.
Believe me, I wish I didn't have to send these emails. But they are necessary if we're going to win. So I am formally asking:
[**Can you please use this link to contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I would not be asking were these emails not absolutely critical to our success.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240814-1-900&t=2&akid=1775%2E135344%2EE10vVD)

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: VICTORY: Ilhan Omar handily wins her primary!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Breaking news, Peter:

The Democratic primary election in MN-05 is over, and Justice Democrats
incumbent Rep. Ilhan Omar has handily won re-election!

In Don Samuels’ 2nd-attempt to challenge Ilhan, she expanded her victory
to 13 points, increasing her margin of victory by more than 10 points —
all despite a last-ditch effort by Samuels and AIPAC allies to coordinate,
organize, and fund Republican support for his campaign.

Ilhan’s victory is a reflection of the progressive leadership that
Democratic voters want to see in Congress when their elections are not
turned into auctions for the highest billionaire bidders. Justice
Democrats has supported and endorsed Ilhan since her first race in 2018
when she was elected one of our first progressive champions in Congress.

Since then, Ilhan has been a national leader on progressive policies that
put the people of MN-05 first, including the Homes for All Act which would
make a homes guarantee a reality, and the Universal School Meals Act which
would guarantee free school meals for every child nationwide—which local
leaders used as a model when they passed a state-level counterpart signed
into law by Minnesota Governor Tim Walz.

She’s also been an outspoken leader for progressive foreign policy from
her Pathway to PEACE platform to a ceasefire in Gaza, while serving
families and children with visionary policies on housing, food costs,
justice reform, healthcare, and climate change. She cruised to re-election
because of that leadership, not in spite of it.

Ilhan truly embodies what it looks like to lead with a vision for her
community’s future in mind at the federal level while delivering real
results for the people of her district every day. We couldn’t be more
proud of her work and this win to keep her fighting in Congress.

Yesterday’s election was the last 2024 Democratic primary during which a
member of the Squad will face off against AIPAC-backed opponents. This
year has proven that right-wing interests and MAGA megadonors see the
Squad as an existential threat to their extremist agenda.

In nearly every primary this cycle, our progressive champions in Congress
faced the organized efforts of AIPAC, Republican megadonors, right-wing
Super PACs, and corporate interests who were united in their desire to
drag our democracy through the mud to protect their own self-interests and
profits.

This race looks more like what our democracy could look like if we end the
influence and bottomless spending of dark money corporate Super PACs in
our elections and put people back at the center of our democracy, and
democracy back at the center of our Party.

Our movement has suffered immeasurable losses this cycle, but the backlash
from monied corporate and right-wing interests proves not only are we
succeeding — but our mandate to elect more Justice Democrats and take big
money out of politics is abundantly clear.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240814.2fqxgO&refcode=em20240814-35911&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35911%2E1203867%2EOuIJnn ]Today, we celebrate this win, but tomorrow, we get back to work to
regroup and rebuild our young, diverse, working-class bloc of progressives
in Congress. If you can, help us get started by pitching in
$5 now.

Thanks for all you’ve done to fuel Justice Democrats, protect the Squad,
and re-elect leaders like Ilhan during this critical primary election
season.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

clean_body: What we’ve always feared | | | | | | Peter— Recently we filed federal complaints on behalf of two women who were denied life-threatening treatment for ectopic pregnancies at Texas hospitals.These are not isolated incidents—they are part of a broader, dangerous trend of pregnant people being kept from the care they need due to restrictive abortion laws. But it's not just pregnant people who are facing the devastating impact of these laws. A new study has confirmed our worst fears—** The Journal of the American Medical Association Pediatrics reports a nearly13% increase in infant deaths in Texas since the abortion ban in 2021. These findings come weeks after the Texas Supreme Court reaffirmed that abortions are not allowed for even lethal fetal conditions. The ruling forces people to continue doomed pregnancies against their will.** The Center for Reproductive Rights has been fighting S.B. 8, Texas’ vigilante abortion ban from the start. We know the harm laws like this cause, and with your support, we’ll continue to confront anti-abortion extremists in Texas and beyond. In solidarity, Nicolas Kabat Staff Attorney | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. © Center for Reproductive Rights | | Center for Reproductive Rights 199 Water St. New York, NY 10038 United States

| | **✅ Tom Kean, Jr. Visits FY25 Community Project Site in Washington Township ✅**
---
| | On August 9th, Tom toured the _**Washington Township Police Department**_ in Morris County ahead of the FY25 appropriations discussion to gain insight into local law enforcement needs and priorities. Tom has requested __**$560,000**__ for the Township in this year’s FY25 appropriations process. This funding would be used for communication technology upgrades for emergency operations of the police department to allow the agency to meet the growing needs of the community. “We appreciate the hard work and dedication of our Police Department to ensure the residents of Washington Township live in one of the safest towns in New Jersey. This funding included in the federal budget by Congressman Kean will help to support the infrastructure of our police department’s headquarters building.” \- _**Matthew Murello, Washington Township Mayor**_ “I am honored that the Congressman would take the time to visit our headquarters and take the time to see how the grant money would be used. I am exceptionally proud of my officers and the department, and this will help us continue to be one of the best with one of the finest facilities.” \- _**Jeffrey Almer, Washington Township Police Chief **_

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! We are nearing the RED ZONE. There are only 83 days until the Election. I wanted to check in to see if we could get you on board yet to help re-elect Tom Kean, Jr. Since my last update, Tom has been back in the district during the Congressional Summer Recess. He's been out knocking doors and speaking to voters, visiting project sites for the upcoming FY25 appropriations process, touring fire stations on his "Fire Grants Tour", meeting with constituents and advocacy groups, and attending many fun-filled summer fairs. Have you seen Tom at an event recently? Our Field Team has been hitting the pavement and phones - and is growing by the day. We expanded our team by bringing on a dedicated field staffer for Warren and Sussex - two key counties for our path to victory. Our volunteers have been energized as they help close out the summer voter contact push. More on all this hard work below. Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved, . Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | | | | | | ✅ Tom Kean, Jr. Visits FY25 Community Project Site in Washington Township ✅ | | On August 9th, Tom toured the Washington Township Police Department in Morris County ahead of the FY25 appropriations discussion to gain insight into local law enforcement needs and priorities. Tom has requested $560,000 for the Township in this year’s FY25 appropriations process. This funding would be used for communication technology upgrades for emergency operations of the police department to allow the agency to meet the growing needs of the community. “We appreciate the hard work and dedication of our Police Department to ensure the residents of Washington Township live in one of the safest towns in New Jersey. This funding included in the federal budget by Congressman Kean will help to support the infrastructure of our police department’s headquarters building.” \- Matthew Murello, Washington Township Mayor “I am honored that the Congressman would take the time to visit our headquarters and take the time to see how the grant money would be used. I am exceptionally proud of my officers and the department, and this will help us continue to be one of the best with one of the finest facilities.” \- Jeffrey Almer, Washington Township Police Chief | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | This past week, our Field Team was busy with candidate and volunteer trainings, door-launches, phone banks, and letter writing! We were on the ground at the Morris County 4H Fair, the Warren County Fair, and the Somerset County 4H Fair! Tom was able to attend some of these great events (check out those great pictures) with Curtis Bashaw, and county leaders like Senator Doug Steinhardt. Summer fairs and New Jersey? Perfect together. In the past 10 days, Tom has visited every county. Our door knocking program has continued with efforts covering towns like Hampton Borough , Bernards Township , Mendham Borough, New Providence , Westfield , Scotch Plains, Rahway , Raritan Borough , and Bridgewater! Recently, with the help of our locals and volunteers, we have been able to canvass over 3,000 doors. We also are hosting launches in coordination with our county and municipal organizations this weekend in Washington Township. We hope to see you there. Kean for Congress held our weekly phone bank series in both Morris and Somerset county. There, we continued to engage in conversations with the critical swing-voter universe. Last week alone, we hit our highest number of phone calls in for a phone bank since before the primary - with over 10,700 calls made! In the past 10 days, we have made over 21,000 calls to voters. We have a few more phone banks lined up in the coming weeks that you can join! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🚨 Endorsement Alerts 🚨 | | | | | Since my last update, Tom has announced some HUGE endorsements. Kean for Congress has now announced new endorsements from: the National Association of Police Organizations and the Professional Firefighters Association of New Jersey! body:
It’s Obamamania 2.0

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=harris_mania&n=1)
---
Peter,

They called it Obamamania, and it was _everywhere_.

When Barack Obama burst onto the scene in 2008, his contrast to Hillary Clinton was remarkable.

He opposed the Iraq War. He supported a public option to open up healthcare for tens of millions of Americans. He called for sweeping investments in working families, and he called for climate policies that no other Democrat would talk about.

Millions believed him. _But it was all a lie.

_ The Obama administration was not the much-needed march towards a better future, not even remotely. In nearly every meaningful way, Obama made the future we are fighting for harder to achieve.

**Obama put kids in cages before Trump did** , and earned the nickname “Deporter In Chief” for his cruel immigration policies.

**Obama killed the public option** in the Affordable Care Act in an act of total surrender to Big Insurance. He repeatedly **bailed out greedy corporate executives** but never the American worker.

Worst of all, this so-called anti-war president decimated our movement for peace. **Obama took us from two wars to SEVEN, expanded mass surveillance, and viciously persecuted whistleblowers.

** We didn’t know much about Obama going into his presidency, we had to learn all this the hard way.

But we know a LOT more about Kamala Harris.

From her record as a prosecutor facilitating mass incarceration, to her active support of genocide, and her total capitulation to corporate power on progressive issues from banning fracking to guaranteeing healthcare...

In every single way, a Harris Presidency is a continuation of the corporate politics and popular revolt that delivered the White House to a cartoon villain in the first place.

Indeed, we can be certain that “Nothing will fundamentally change” under Harris. And that is the problem.

**We need much more than fundamental change. We need a radical transformation of our social and political landscape – or the next cartoon villain elected may be competent enough to finish us off.

** They called it Obamamania in 2008. In 2024, it’s been rebranded as Kamalanomenon.

They fooled us once. We won’t be fooled again.

**[It remains true that there is ONLY ONE anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a pathway to the White House this November – ours. We need your financial support to deliver our mandate at the ballot box.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=harris_mania&n=2)**

Behind the fervor and the sign-waving and the lofty, aspirational-sounding speeches lies a decades-long record of lip service and broken promises.

We know better now. And the moment is so much more urgent than before. Neither our planet nor our democracy has another 16 years to experiment with little tweaks and fixes. NOW is the time to go bold.

**[I’m asking you to invest in the radical transformation that this moment demands. Will you join us?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=harris_mania&n=4)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/EK7ooP2i76bKumuiOBQqEg~~/AARclAA~/RgRon2q6P0RwaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtd2Fsei1taWxpdGFyeS12amQtcG9wLz91dG1fdGM9VUNOMi0yMDI0MDgxNFcDc3BjQgpmu2XRvGbCW1Y0UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90809032/491739715/1610638071?refcode=em20240814mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=3d3be845-565a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDNiZTg0NS01NjVhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ahJQIiJ09ORtDjhDmTy1Osgl78-UAz6TwnvEqh-UVzs=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

It’s a humanitarian issue. It affects men and women, girls and boys. Because men don’t want to see women robbed of their opportunities or put in danger. And every person has the right to speak the truth. Will you help me speak louder and strengthen this movement? Leftist schools intimidate America’s daughters. Friends,
I have written to you several times over the last few months on the successes our State Freedom Caucuses have had in both defending their seats and picking up news ones in this year's primary elections.
In the last two weeks, Arizona and Missouri held their elections and I am happy to report that streak continued.
In Arizona's July 30 primaries, AZFC member Rep. Justin Heap won a major victory, unseating RINO incumbent Stephen Richer in the Republican Primary for Maricopa County Recorder. Arizona has been a major battleground in the fight for election integrity and Richer was at the forefront of defending the disastrous way that the state's largest county conducted their elections over the last few years.
Republicans in AZ can be rest assured that a strong conservative who actually cares about securing elections will be the top elections official in Maricopa County when Rep. Heap wins in November.
The AZ Freedom Caucus successfully defended all but one of their seats, and will also pick up new seats in both the state senate and state house, a reflection of their growing power under the amazing leadership of AZFC Chair Jake Hoffman and Vice-Chair Joseph Chaplik.
Missouri also saw a huge victory as founding MOFC member Sen. Denny Hoskins won the Republican Primary for Secretary of State. With millions of establishment dollars going to his opponents, Sen. Hoskins emerged victorious from a crowded eight-way primary.
He will be one of the first State Freedom Caucus members elected to statewide office when he wins in November.
Also, former state senator and MOFC emeritus member Bob Onder won his primary for Missouri's 3rd congressional district. Since this is a heavily Republican district, Onder should win in November. Picking up this seat is what we call a "double whammy" \- not only will Onder be a House Freedom Caucus member in DC, but he is also replacing a retiring RINO Republican who was hostile to the HFC.
Just two years ago, Missouri had zero members in the House Freedom Caucus in Washington. Now they have two, with Onder joining current first-term Congressman Eric Burlison.
MOFC member Sen. Bill Eigel unfortunately finished second in the Republican primary for Governor, running an extremely competitive race against big time establishment money. We're sadly going to be without Eigel in the state senate going forward, but he will remain a strong leader in the state's growing conservative movement thanks to the increasing influence of the Missouri Freedom Caucus.
MOFC Chairman Sen. Rick Brattin also comfortably won his primary against an extremely well-funded challenger, all of our members in the Missouri House won re-election, and candidates endorsed by the MOFC in four out of five Senate races won their primary elections as well.
With a member who will be taking statewide office next year, an insurgent candidate who came within striking distance of becoming the state's governor, and massive success in legislative races, the Missouri Freedom Caucus is going to be a powerful force for many years to come.
When you actually fight for conservative principles, the grassroots will stand with you come election time. That's what State Freedom Caucuses are proving time and time again,
August 20 will be our last primary election of the year as Wyoming heads to the polls where we hope to once again replicate our success.

Peter,
It’s official: reproductive rights will be on the ballot in November.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=amendment3_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=amendment3_image]
Amendment 3 will overturn Missouri’s total ban on abortion by guaranteeing a constitutional right to an abortion until fetal viability (around 24 weeks). After viability, the amendment allows for a better-defined exception for abortions needed when the life or health of the mother is at risk. Amendment 3 will also establish a patient’s right to make decisions about reproductive healthcare, including contraception, without governmental interference.
This is fantastic news, but we absolutely must have more Democratic voices of sanity, common sense, and respect for democracy in the State Senate to ensure that this measure is enacted with no political gamesmanship or cynical attempts to undermine these (and other) fundamental rights.
The extremists who have dominated the Missouri Senate have shown time and again that they cannot be trusted to do the right thing, even when the people speak with one voice, loudly and clearly. We must also defeat them at the ballot box —and the path to doing this requires us to win my race in Senate District 15 and flip this seat red to blue .

_I have major election integrity news to share with you from Arizona. _
My team at America First Legal just sent legal demand letters to all 15 Arizona County Recorders demanding they take action to remove foreign citizens from their voter rolls.
_Some background on this situation... _
**As of April, there were 35,273 registered voters in Arizona who had failed to provide proof of their citizenship, but had not yet been removed from the voter rolls. This is unacceptable and a serious threat to the integrity of the upcoming federal elections. **
_For comparison, the 2020 presidential election in Arizona was decided by only 10,457 votes... _
Meanwhile, Arizona law requires county recorders to perform monthly list maintenance to confirm the citizenship of federal-only registered voters. The list maintenance law requires county recorders to consult three specific databases to check the citizenship of registrants.
However, Arizona Secretary of State Adrian Fontes has never negotiated with the relevant agencies to get access to those databases for list maintenance. **_Because of this, county recorders are not performing the necessary list maintenance to verify the citizenship of federal-only voters_.**
**This is unacceptable. This is criminal, and clearly designed to allow voter fraud. **

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

subject: ICYMI: My op-ed on Youngkin's illegal climate rollbacks

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/virginians-for-jay-jones [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/virginians-for-jay-jones]
Friend,
I hope you will take a moment to read my op-ed in The Richmond Times-Dispatch on Glenn Youngkin's illegal climate rollbacks.
The Richmond Times-Dispatch: Youngkin's climate rollbacks aren't just out of touch, they're illegal [https://richmond.com/opinion/column/youngkin-climate-rggi-california-rollbacks-violate-law/article_8156220e-535e-11ef-bfc8-6f6507e778ab.html]
This summer has been sweltering. For much of June and July we’ve been under extreme heat advisories, with temperatures well into triple digits. This isn’t normal – this is dangerous. This is climate change. And, in all likelihood, this is a harbinger of the new normal unless we fully commit to tackling this environmental crisis head-on by doing everything we can to cut pollution and transition to a clean energy future.
As a Delegate, my fellow lawmakers and I took this threat seriously and passed a number of landmark policies aimed at charting a path to a secure energy future. These included the 2020 Virginia Clean Economy Act [https://virginiamercury.com/2020/03/06/virginia-clean-economy-act-clears-general-assembly-aided-by-beefed-up-ratepayer-protections/] (VCEA), our Commonwealth’s roadmap to reach 100% clean energy by 2045 and create thousands of new jobs, lower household energy costs, and drive the kind of economic growth we’re starting to see in Hampton Roads due to offshore wind deployment.
In that same legislative session, the General Assembly also voted to join the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) [https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-solutions/virginia-becomes-the-first-southern-state-with-a-goal-of-carbon-free-energy/2020/04/13/4ef22dd6-7db5-11ea-8013-1b6da0e4a2b7_story.html] , cut power plant pollution, reduce Virginians’ energy costs, and keep communities safe from flooding. In 2021 the legislature voted to adopt the Advanced Clean Car Standards (Clean Cars) [https://virginiamercury.com/2021/02/19/continuing-climate-change-fight-virginia-lawmakers-commit-to-clean-car-standards/] , an effort that addressed our largest source of pollution by working to bring cleaner and in-demand plug-in hybrid and electric vehicles to auto dealerships here in Virginia as we transition to a more secure energy future.
Sadly, Governor Youngkin has wasted no time in sabotaging these major climate policies. In an unprecedented and unconstitutional use of executive branch authority, Governor Youngkin unilaterally removed Virginia from RGGI, resulting in legal action [https://www.southernenvironment.org/news/were-suing-to-hold-the-line-on-virginias-climate-progress/] that is currently in progress. Moreover, in June the Governor moved to end Virginia’s participation in Clean Cars, even as Virginians suffered record high temperatures brought on by climate change.
Both of these climate rollbacks have one thing in common: they ignore and undermine legislation passed by the General Assembly and signed into law. Governor Youngkin has simply opted to ignore the laws he swore to uphold and enforce in his inaugural oath, and Virginians will be in harm’s way as a result.
In the three years that Virginia was actively a part of RGGI [https://www.southernenvironment.org/topic/regional-greenhouse-gas-initiative/#:~:text=What%20impact%20has%20the%20Regional,anywhere%20else%20in%20the%20country.] , we saw a 22% drop in air pollution from power plants and upwards of $830 million to help reduce Virginians’ energy bills and protect communities from flooding.
Hampton Roads, where five generations of Joneses were born and raised and still call home, is second only to New Orleans [https://www.hrtpo.org/381/Coastal-Resiliency-Sea-Level-Rise] in its vulnerability to rising sea levels. We grapple with flooding in our streets, homes, and businesses on a regular basis - even on dry, sunny days. Taking resources away at a time when extreme weather and the threat of rising waters is only getting worse isn’t just bad policy, it’s irresponsible.
Likewise, the scorching heat reminds us each month just how much it costs to keep cool. It is no secret that greater energy efficiency not only lowers household costs, but also lowers demand on power plants and cleans our air. But Virginians are now paying the price for Governor Youngkin’s reckless withdrawal from RGGI’s energy efficiency programs.
Under standards enumerated in Clean Cars, Virginia was poised to see cleaner air, improved public health, and a stronger economy. According to the American Lung Association [https://perma.cc/T5SK-AGKR] , widespread transition to clean electric vehicles could, by mid-century, help Virginians avoid billions in annual health costs, innumerable premature deaths, and thousands more asthma attacks and lost workdays each year by cutting the air pollution that is disproportionately concentrated in low-wealth communities and communities of color.
In pulling Virginia out of this program, Governor Youngkin was armed only with a flimsy opinion from the Attorney General that conflicts with his own office’s earlier position [https://virginiamercury.com/2022/08/26/californias-2035-ban-on-new-gas-powered-cars-set-to-apply-to-virginia/] that repealing Clean Cars would require “an amendment or repeal of the mandating legislation.” The executive branch cannot simply ignore the law – and the two-thirds of Virginia voters [https://cnu.edu/wasoncenter/surveys/archive/2023-01-27.html] who want to see their elected leaders prioritize climate action – to suit its own out-of-touch political agenda.
This is the democratic process – policy arguments are won or lost at the ballot box. No elected official is above the law, and Virginians deserve better.
- Jay

As a Delegate, my fellow lawmakers and I took this threat seriously and passed a number of landmark policies aimed at charting a path to a secure energy future. In 2021 the legislature voted to adopt the Advanced Clean Car Standards (Clean Cars) [] , an effort that addressed our largest source of pollution by working to bring cleaner and in-demand plug-in hybrid and electric vehicles to auto dealerships here in Virginia as we transition to a more secure energy future. Sadly, Governor Youngkin has wasted no time in sabotaging these major climate policies. In an unprecedented and unconstitutional use of executive branch authority, Governor Youngkin unilaterally removed Virginia from RGGI, resulting in legal action [] that is currently in progress. Moreover, in June the Governor moved to end Virginia’s participation in Clean Cars, even as Virginians suffered record high temperatures brought on by climate change. Both of these climate rollbacks have one thing in common: they ignore and undermine legislation passed by the General Assembly and signed into law. Governor Youngkin has simply opted to ignore the laws he swore to uphold and enforce in his inaugural oath, and Virginians will be in harm’s way as a result. In the three years that Virginia was actively a part of RGGI [.] , we saw a 22% drop in air pollution from power plants and upwards of $830 million to help reduce Virginians’ energy bills and protect communities from flooding. Hampton Roads, where five generations of Joneses were born and raised and still call home, is second only to New Orleans [] in its vulnerability to rising sea levels. We grapple with flooding in our streets, homes, and businesses on a regular basis - even on dry, sunny days. Taking resources away at a time when extreme weather and the threat of rising waters is only getting worse isn’t just bad policy, it’s irresponsible. Likewise, the scorching heat reminds us each month just how much it costs to keep cool. It is no secret that greater energy efficiency not only lowers household costs, but also lowers demand on power plants and cleans our air. But Virginians are now paying the price for Governor Youngkin’s reckless withdrawal from RGGI’s energy efficiency programs. body:
Known bigot and homophobe wants to ban drag – but he can do it.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90816786/491765687/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwN2U1MjctNjI1YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=E0Pbnx6BrjA4U2TbCvUhxS68buXWl-I8e6_UfiBIHqg=&emci=58a2e521-625a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7807e527-625a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Have you seen these photos, Peter?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90816788/491765689/2081106790?refcode=20240814-EM-JDVanceDrag&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwN2U1MjctNjI1YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=E0Pbnx6BrjA4U2TbCvUhxS68buXWl-I8e6_UfiBIHqg=)
Probably not.
**These are photos of JD Vance from college, as confirmed by a representative for his office and the fact-checking website _Snopes_. **
Yes, this is the same JD Vance who has cut his teeth in politics by promoting anti-LGBTQ issues like criminalizing gender-affirming care for minors, getting LGBTQ+ identities off the U.S. census, and calling LGBTQ+ people and advocates “groomers.”
**JD Vance’s hypocrisy should be all over the news, but the legacy media has been dead silent since the photos emerged online nearly two days ago.**
[**We’ll explain why in a sec, but if you support COURIER’s efforts to cover the 2024 election, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90816798/491765691/-593472309?refcode=20240814-EM-JDVanceDrag&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwN2U1MjctNjI1YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=E0Pbnx6BrjA4U2TbCvUhxS68buXWl-I8e6_UfiBIHqg=)
Here’s the thing, Peter: we don’t care whether JD Vance dressed in drag in college, or if he still likes to dress in drag now. We don’t think how people dress and express their identities is any of our business (or anyone else’s).
**But you know who does? JD Vance.**
Like many in the MAGA-right, Vance has climbed to the top of the Republican party by attacking the LGBTQ+ community to create a climate of fear and a moral panic among his base. This is the same guy who called married father of two Pete Buttigieg “a childless cat lady” because Vance doesn’t see Secretary Pete’s family make-up as valid as his own.
The consequence of Vance and the far-right’s demagoguery has been a dangerous rollback of rights and protections. According to the Human Rights Campaign, anti-LGBTQ+ legislation exploded in state legislatures 2023. Not only that, but in 2023 there was more than a 30% increase in violence against the LGBTQ+ community.
**And we know it’s only going to get worse if Trump and Vance win. Project 2025 would end federal protections designed to stop discrimination on the basis of “sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, and sex characteristics.”**
Peter, Vance wearing drag isn’t a major story, but his hypocrisy and anti-LGBTQ+ agenda are. And while LGBTQ+ publications like _Out_ and _The Advocate_ are publishing the photos, the legacy media is trying to bury it.
Imagine if these photos were of Tim Walz, do you think _Fox News_ would ignore it? You already know the answer to that.
At COURIER, we believe the mainstream media should be calling out Vance’s hypocrisy instead of hiding it.
There’s too much on the line for the LGBTQ+ community. That’s why we offer our factual reporting for free in 11 battleground states across the country.

body:
What a whirlwind this campaign has been so far.
#
What a whirlwind this campaign has been so far. And to think we’re just two weeks away from early voting in the primary!
I don’t know about you, but I’m feeling more hopeful and energized than ever. I’m ready to win this race, elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz in November, and get to work for our neighbors in Congress.
If we keep control of the White House and flip the House, we’ll have an opportunity to do _so much good_ next year. We’ll build on the work the Biden administration has already started and do even more to make government work for our neighbors.
But that outcome isn’t guaranteed — there’s a lot of work to do first, and the primary election on September 10th presents our next big test. So with just two weeks left until early voting begins, my whole team and I are working as hard as ever to keep reaching out to voters.

NEWS: Welcome to Remerville: the Largest San Diego River Homeless Encampment in the City's History | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c9379bf55854/news-welcome-to-remerville-the-largest-san-diego-river-homeless-encampment-in-the-citys-history?e=784f78234b)

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 14, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Welcome to** _**Remerville**_**: The Largest San Diego River Homeless Encampment in the City's History**
San Diego, CA—Today, former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer is sounding the alarm yet again on a growing crisis that has culminated in the largest homeless encampment ever seen along the San Diego River. Remerville is a tragic symbol of failure that underscores the rapid and devastating increase in homelessness under the lack of leadership of Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer.
Over the past few years, homelessness in San Diego County has spiraled out of control with the number of unsheltered individuals [reaching unprecedented levels](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=494b212cf4&e=784f78234b). The rise in homelessness has not only brought more people to the streets but has also led to a disturbing [increase in homeless deaths](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=660f3351e9&e=784f78234b), a sobering reality that has worsened under Lawson-Remer.

---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=b825f63af5&e=784f78234b)
[CLICK HERE TO WATCH: “Remerville”](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=241332b72a&e=784f78234b)
| Remerville is more than just a tent city—it is both an environmental and human tragedy unfolding before our eyes. Situated along the banks of the San Diego River, this encampment is wreaking havoc on one of our city’s most precious natural resources. Waste, garbage, and human feces are being funneled directly into the river, threatening the ecosystem and the health of our community. The river, once a cherished symbol of natural beauty, is now a polluted conduit of disease and despair.
But the dangers extend beyond environmental degradation. Remerville has become an open-air drug market, where daily drug deals occur, endangering both the vulnerable residents of the encampment and the broader community. The potential for violence and overdose deaths is ever-present, making it clear that this crisis is not just a matter of homelessness but a public safety emergency that demands immediate action.
_**“The situation along the San Diego River is untenable. Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer's policies have failed our most vulnerable residents, our environment, and our county as a whole," said Kevin Faulconer, candidate for supervisor. "We cannot afford to stand by as this crisis escalates. Immediate, effective intervention is required to prevent further loss of life and protect our environment. When I was mayor, we didn’t allow tent encampments like this to flourish on our canyons, riverbeds or sidewalks. We intervened in people’s lives because we cared enough not to let them die. That’s not what is happening today, and I will change it when we oust do-nothing Lawson-Remer this November.”**_
As San Diego Mayor, Kevin Faulconer worked to reduce homelessness by double digits as other cities saw increases. He moved people to the safety of shelters where they provided housing navigators and mental health resources to turn lives around. As Supervisor, he will follow the same approach, working with local authorities to ensure streets are cleaned and open-air drug markets are shut down to prevent further tragedies from taking place on our streets.

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE files amicus brief defending Arizona law requiring proof of citizenship to vote by mail
body:
Safeguards ensure absentee voting maintains its integrity |
---
| |
---
| |
# RITE Defends Arizona law Requiring Proof of Citizenship to Vote by Mail
#
(WASHINGTON, DC – August 14, 2024) – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today [filed an amicus brief in the U.S. Supreme Court ](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=950bbafc3d&e=ea91f782ea)in support of an Arizona law that requires proof of citizenship to vote by mail. The brief asks the court to allow the enforcement of a state law, enjoined by the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals, that prevents Arizona from enforcing this commonsense election integrity measure, including during the fast-approaching presidential election.
#
The brief argues that the lower court improperly held that the federal National Voter Registration Act supersedes the Arizona law, even though that federal law regulates only voter registration and says nothing about how states regulate access to various methods of voting, including early voting and voting by mail.

“Like most States, Arizona has long provided opportunities for voters to cast a ballot by mail—with safeguards to ensure that the absentee ballot process maintains its integrity,” the brief states. “One of those safeguards is that applicants must provide documentary proof of citizenship to vote by mail. Other voters who have properly registered may still vote in-person, either during Arizona’s generous early voting period or on Election Day.”

RITE asked the Supreme Court to enter a stay of the 9th Circuit injunction to allow the Arizona law to be enforced.

“Effectively, the district court’s preemption approach would seem to mandate nationwide, no-excuse absentee balloting,” the brief argues. “The injunction poses special harms to Arizona’s own significant interest in protecting the integrity of its elections. Absentee balloting is notoriously the type of voting most subject to fraud, mistakes, and manipulation.”

In the amicus brief in support of a suit by the Republican National Committee, RITE was joined by the Honest Elections Project, a non-partisan organization that supports free and fair elections, and the Center for Election Confidence, a non-profit group that promotes ethics, integrity, and professionalism in the electoral process. The title of the case is Republican National Committee, et al v. Mi Familia Vota, et al.
# ###

| Hi Friend,
John Carter was almost 24 years old, and about to enter law school, when the Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed.
Even if he didn't read the news the next day, he certainly heard about this new law banning racist literacy tests and other methods legislators had used to disenfranchise minority voters. After all, the law prohibited the English proficiency tests that Texas was using when Carter became eligible to vote.
But it's been 59 years since Lyndon Baines Johnson -- a Texan, and a Democrat -- signed the Voting Rights Act into law, and sometimes memory fades.
Perhaps that explains why Carter has gone on the record stating that literacy tests should (and legally can) be added as a requirement for voting:
---
| |
### "I simply believe you should be able to read, write and speak English to be a voter in the United States."
---
| I'm certainly not the first person to call John Carter out for his shameful position on literacy tests (with your help this election, we can make sure I'm the last). Even Esquire magazine has written about how wrong he is on this:
---
| |
### "Carter believes we should go back to requiring voters to submit to literacy tests (i.e., proficiency in English), which the Voting Rights Act would kinda frown on."
---
| Personally, I'd change "would kinda frown on" to something that makes this crystal clear -- literacy tests are a shameful part of our country's history, and I'll fight to make sure Texans aren't forced to repeat it.
It's difficult enough to vote already. Texas has the most restrictive voting laws in the country, and we regularly rank at the bottom of the country in turnout.
But the idea that we would impose an additional literacy test? A test that's banned by federal law, that was used historically to keep minorities from voting, and that would be yet another barrier to full participation in our democracy?
As one lawyer to another: John, you should know better.
[Help me defeat him in November:](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H3ECl0O6RZrHzM6GaRqDwmDRwhxnNAH99MbueUTVi4ndbg0iLZCyoYjD9_qqOBYsjRI_wJC2cOWr7tDbInwL4SqBSLxNE2wjKEwJnTTYzsntwTshN_5I3SSXp4f4Ix2D-ORW0LjvgkS7Mds0YP8tVcBevZ5_X32GYK_UWi6i7XiPNdQjf82BCHgYAVDndzYkie6NzRWIOdMTlykDVDlZJw==&c=qSvsq6I25ODmW1MEvUeCwabBzS0LASmS8bPfBGd2HSGGK6ks5PHIzg==&ch=cn-XoVBQhzFxgflc0-ow6Ok6ED3VbEP6OP8pag1-ZhChdoADjULDGQ==)

clean_body: That’s John Carter’s position | | | | == | == | Hi Friend, John Carter was almost 24 years old, and about to enter law school, when the Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed. Even if he didn't read the news the next day, he certainly heard about this new law banning racist literacy tests and other methods legislators had used to disenfranchise minority voters. After all, the law prohibited the English proficiency tests that Texas was using when Carter became eligible to vote. But it's been 59 years since Lyndon Baines Johnson -- a Texan, and a Democrat -- signed the Voting Rights Act into law, and sometimes memory fades. Perhaps that explains why Carter has gone on the record stating that literacy tests should (and legally can) be added as a requirement for voting: | | "I simply believe you should be able to read, write and speak English to be a voter in the United States." | I'm certainly not the first person to call John Carter out for his shameful position on literacy tests (with your help this election, we can make sure I'm the last). Even Esquire magazine has written about how wrong he is on this: | | "Carter believes we should go back to requiring voters to submit to literacy tests (i.e., proficiency in English), which the Voting Rights Act would kinda frown on." | Personally, I'd change "would kinda frown on" to something that makes this crystal clear -- literacy tests are a shameful part of our country's history, and I'll fight to make sure Texans aren't forced to repeat it. It's difficult enough to vote already. Texas has the most restrictive voting laws in the country, and we regularly rank at the bottom of the country in turnout. But the idea that we would impose an additional literacy test? A test that's banned by federal law, that was used historically to keep minorities from voting, and that would be yet another barrier to full participation in our democracy? As one lawyer to another: John, you should know better. == | | == | Supporting our right to vote, | | Stuart Whitlow, Democrat for Texas Congressional District 31 == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | | == Democrat Stuart Whitlow is running to unseat Trump's ally in Congress, MAGA Republican John Carter. Hi Peter,
Thank you so much for your support of my bid for Congress. We launched this campaign to lift up our community and bring new voices to the table. Unfortunately, we came up 4 votes short yesterday.
This campaign was never about one person. It was about you - the community.
Although we did not win the election, I believe we empowered the community and gave them an alternative to the same voices and choices that deliver the same results. Instead, we amplified their voices and had a plan for change that they continue to embrace. We were able to do that because of the support of friends, neighbors, donors, volunteers, and countless others.
I want to also express my congratulations to Mayor Sylvester Turner and I look forward to helping the entire Democratic ticket this fall. My focus and all of our focus should be on the next 83 days. Democracy is on the line on November 5th and it is time to roll up our sleeves and get to work.
Please continue to stay engaged in the process so that the community can reach its full potential.
Onwards,
Amanda K. Edwards

subject: Breaking the cycle of abuse in our politics
body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
It is easy to get discouraged when, day after day, the women of this country have to watch the damage that abusers and abuse enablers like Donald Trump, Jim Jordan, and J.D. Vance inflict on our society.
But let me be the first to say that last weekend’s event, the Ladies Lead-HER-ship Luncheon, was a breath of fresh air and truly inspiring.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240814_luncheon_recap_image1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240814_luncheon_recap_image1]
We met with a group of extraordinary individuals who unmasked the widespread culture of abuse and enablement in our society and the Republican Party.
This was an afternoon dedicated to dismantling that toxic environment and charting a path forward—a path led by strong, compassionate women.
If you're as fired up as we are about ending systems of exploitation and electing leaders who genuinely care about the well-being of our communities, now is the time to take action. Your contribution today will help us continue this fight and ensure that voices like those we heard this weekend are amplified in Washington. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240814_luncheon_recap_link1]
Here are just a few highlights from our event:
We heard from an Ohio State victim who courageously spoke out against the abuse he and others endured and the systemic failures and Jim Jordan’s cowardice that allowed the abuse to continue for years.
Nearly 2,000 students and athletes have come forward – that’s right, 2,000!!!
Just think about that for a minute. Jordan could have saved hundreds or even thousands of students from being violated, but he didn’t do a damn thing. He went along with it just like he did on January 6th!
We also listened to a mother’s story whose son tragically took his own life after being sextorted. It took her 11 months to get in her son’s cell phone to find out what triggered him to commit suicide.
This mother wrote legislation requiring parents access to their children’s cell phone within 3 days after such a tragedy. I will be taking her legislation to Washington – making this the 10th bill I’m bringing to the job on DAY ONE.
Another mother shared her hopes for a future where her son, who recently came out, can grow up in a community that loves and supports him.
Each of these stories were a poignant reminder of what’s at stake in this election and why we must fight back against the forces of harassment, hate, and harm.
We also heard from candidates and community leaders for a heartfelt conversation of the future we are building – one where women are fully empowered and leading the way!
While Jordan and his deranged Project 2025 buddies continue to push their dangerous, abusive agendas, we are standing up for ALL people, especially the ones they’ve cruelly left behind.
Make no mistake; the ULTRA-MAGA agenda wants to force us back to a time before women had the right to vote and to have their own bank accounts – in fact, they’d prefer we weren’t considered citizens at all.
Not on our watch, you have my word !
Our campaign is about electing powerful women and Democrats who care, who listen, and who act.
That’s the kind of leader I am. I’m not waiting to get to Washington to start making a difference; I’m doing it now, right here in Ohio.
Last weekend’s event was a powerful reminder that women are leading the way forward.
Together, we can dismantle the culture of abuse and build a future where compassion, justice, and equality reign. Let's keep this momentum going – help fuel our movement and make a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240814_luncheon_recap_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

After 18 months of campaigning for the U.S. Senate to save Virginia and save America, Jonathan W. Emord now moves his battle to the courts. Join Jonathan and ANH-USA in this fight to end the vax mandates, the mask mandates, and Big Tech censorship. Help us restore individual liberty and freedom of choice. | | **For Immediate Release:** August 14, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**ICYMI: BAUGH REMAINS SILENT ON
VANCE’S DESPICABLE COMMENTS**
_At The Invitation Of Scott Baugh
VP Nominee Vance Says Women Should Stay
In Violent Marriages–No Word From Baugh_
**IRVINE, CA** — It’s been one week since the [LA Times](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ff6e44e2fe&e=7017cc100e) and [Orange County Register](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=9d8e18277a&e=7017cc100e) reported that JD Vance’s comments that women in violent marriages should stay in them were made at the invitation of MAGA extremist Scott Baugh. Baugh has yet to respond to these comments, or the fact that he is in lock step with the extremists at the top of his party’s ticket.

In 2021, JD Vance said that women in violent marriages ought to stay with abusive partners for the sake of their children, a chilling addition to a string of disturbing revelations concerning Vance’s views on women and families.**Those comments were made at an event at Pacific Christian, a charter school founded by CA-47’s Republican nominee Scott Baugh – who still refuses to address Vance’s disgusting comments.**

A [spokesperson](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3cef11acbb&e=7017cc100e) for the school described the evening as “wonderful,” and that Vance and his comments were “well-received,” while [Baugh](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=12e837c508&e=7017cc100e) refused to condemn Vance’s harmful insinuation or explain if he still supported the Vice Presidential pick in light of recent revelations.

Sen. Dave Min had much more direct and immediate commentary. **“Those comments were despicable. They are ignorant and reflect an extreme view of the role of women and women’s rights that we’ve seen come out of the far right wing of the Republican Party,”** said Min.

Min has also invited JD Vance and Scott Baugh to come tour the UC Irvine School of Law Domestic Violence Clinic, run by Min’s wife, Professor Jane Stoever, to hear directly from DV survivors and the advocates who represent them. So far, this invitation has not been accepted. Baugh’s comments are just one more proof point showing an obvious trend: Scott Baugh has little to no concern for the health and safety of Orange County’s women and families. His emphatic support of the Trump / Vance ticket is out of step with voters in Orange County.

**“Whether he’s comparing abortion access to slavery, imploring women to stay in abusive relationships, chastising Americans without children or casting himself as the poster boy of Trump’s disastrous Project 2025 agenda that would harm working families, (Vance) offers no shortage of terrible takes that voters will hold against both him and his MAGA extremist friends across the country — and down the ballot — this November,”** said Dan Gottlieb, a spokesperson for the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee.

Min has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by Planned Parenthood and Reproductive Freedom For All (formerly NARAL), as well as by by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, California Lt. Governor Eleni Kounalakis, and over 50 local elected officials. He is also the consensus choice of Teachers, Police, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the Fraternal Order of Police, the Police Officers Research Association of California, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a334e133b5&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c63f67703b&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5c2cd9a534&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

_**Right now, we’re genuinely the underdogs. According to the most recently released public poll, this race is tied. That’s why I had the honor of welcoming the President to Montana Friday evening. He’s all-in for Montana, and we’re all-in for him.**_

Fellow Conservative,

First, I want to thank everyone who donated to my campaign before President Trump’s visit on Friday. Over the week, we hit our goal of raising $50,000 ahead of my sit-down with President Trump and NRSC Chairman Steve Daines.

Hitting goals this close to Election Day is critical, but hitting this goal was more important than most because President Trump spent his valuable time attending a campaign event for me in a state he’s sure to win when he could have been campaigning elsewhere. **_[President Trump showed up for me on Friday evening because he knows how important my race is.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42dc6d8adb574945b79b1ad7337feb4e&_e=eddceeASX5o4lL_LgtAjXMYdYEu8h3XJkZOmiXq4cJX87is0zrJTfLvHRFfpRiNfnXaUYDTtKtLTFy_2ahtmlpvBP9MEAi9G9vIJwiVBnXVoGXtO13jYsHQtuW0OjXUNvuh4vSr5u85dVXSjuJbBJIPg2VLDZhEL2tyxAOkL9v-7VDx2B40AUh2BCvzEawl0nFSIefOQsodNJIfPhpRCkC7Vths6hRcjWTxvZymRG3TL6fzCCjOPaG09xp8iciOKGH439lKqSQAtpAY03qHHIU5Ffq5JjeEVAr6C-_w6_jrFCrBposWjyEZsyu0v0nYfTpsnaS-jMp-tK_y8nDod8MD8n0FGiqiVpx5SC2detqtnsRNV1LIzxWQGCoVZFAXvyamVfqnfPdqoMYg6iVUrgZKAN69vEqFwRbK2Z2A2yvo%3D)_**

**Keep reading below.**

When Trump wins the White House, not having a Republican Senate majority will hamstring his efforts. _**My opponent and his allies know this, which is why they’re spending $120 million to turn out their supporters and tear me down.**_

I’ll cut to the chase: **[I need your financial support to help me reach the 5% of undecided voters in Montana before my opponent.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42dc6d8adb574945b79b1ad7337feb4e&_e=eddceeASX5o4lL_LgtAjXMYdYEu8h3XJkZOmiXq4cJX87is0zrJTfLvHRFfpRiNfnXaUYDTtKtLTFy_2ahtmlpvBP9MEAi9G9vIJwiVBnXVoGXtO13jYsHQtuW0OjXUNvuh4vSr5u85dVXSjuJbBJIPg2VLDZhEL2tyxAOkL9v-7VDx2B40AUh2BCvzEawl0nFSIefOQsodNJIfPhpRCkC7Vths6hRcjWTxvZymRG3TL6fzCCjOPaG09xp8iciOKGH439lKqSQAtpAY03qHHIb5nZsDSPNVWBInsHY3jj-Z8jdpuodNt3VJ9nzXuMkMZgvWBqaueXenbOudtNM2QM8ciAj4y-Tg1gfE3A7iAe_1qPVfUA1U18fVBQqjY7P5MbiiQ1VMbmb-oYCaRoGQ8l1Ljl5tSegBzCZubbYs2wvY%3D) **

[**HELP TIM AND HIS TEAM

**[Please help President Trump and me get this done.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42dc6d8adb574945b79b1ad7337feb4e&_e=eddceeASX5o4lL_LgtAjXMYdYEu8h3XJkZOmiXq4cJX87is0zrJTfLvHRFfpRiNfnXaUYDTtKtLTFy_2ahtmlpvBP9MEAi9G9vIJwiVBnXVoGXtO13jYsHQtuW0OjXUNvuh4vSr5u85dVXSjuJbBJIPg2VLDZhEL2tyxAOkL9v-7VDx2B40AUh2BCvzEawl0nFSIefOQsodNJIfPhpRCkC7Vths6hRcjWTxvZymRG3TL6fzCCjOPaG09xp8iciOKGH439lKqSQAtpAY03qHHIWzjzdpK0KMRqHOwHxJalR4bb0MAfd1JdJE0-iMSPZi9wOvpzyYG_XumtKD0NNfZdg9MgDtzg_7-ClYp7CpYOO_L0U3OefJpo7PYThIOYRoKNn4Ao5tWMiOKqnO1wFBwyRQISI6e_GmWN_yPAb9fcBI%3D)**

| | Dear Freedom Fighters,
_Familiar faces to face off_ _for_ _legislative se_ ats _in November_ “Several of Arizona’s competitive races this November pit familiar faces against each other.” _Arizona Capitol Times_ , July 23, 2024
I returned to the Capitol last year to save our state, including our amazing educational options so kids need not be relegated to their zip code school. Thankfully, the current Republican legislature preserved Arizona’s school choice programs across the board.

Did you know my Democrat opponent only wants to have district school public education for our kids? My kids thrived in _both_ public charter and public district schools.

This past legislative session we made it easier for entrepreneurs to prepare craft foods for sale in their home kitchen. Last year my Democrat opponent voted against this bill saying there should be “a cap on how much people can make.”

Can you imagine a small business owner “limiting” their revenues because the government, a bureaucrat or some politician tells them they are making too much money? Say goodbye to innovation and attracting and retaining top talent in the name of DEI if the Democrats takeover our state legislature.

My Democrat opponent also supported raising minimum wage laws which increased layers of red tape and regulations, driving up costs for our small businesses.

In turn, Arizona’s cost of living has drastically increased since that law took effect, reducing opportunities for employment opportunities across the board, especially entry level positions that help mold our kids into much needed worker bees who will build a strong work ethic while earning a living.

One of the many bipartisan bills I sponsored and passed this session was signed by the current Democrat governor [allowing youth entrepreneurs to sell lemonade](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4ee74b84a6&e=a7ab36849c) by reducing overburdensome regulations on kids. My Democrat opponent voted NO to allow kids to make and sell our state’s drink- lemonade. Even Governor Newsom’s California allows kids to legally run a lemonade stand without getting a seller’s permit from the government.

Last year, the current governor became known as the “veto queen." Knowing Governor Hobbs would most likely continue vetoing good legislation, 11 measures were referred to the ballot for voters to decide in November by the legislature.

Here’s a breakdown of the 2024 Arizona November 5th General Election [Ballot Propositions](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1171b6b5d5&e=a7ab36849c): | **Proposition** | **Title** | **HOW TO VOTE**
---|---|---
133 (HCR2033) | Ban Ranked Choice Voting | YES
134 (SCR1015) | LD Signature Requirements for Ballot Measures | YES
135 (HCR2039) | Governor’s State of Emergency Powers Limited | YES
136 (SCR1041) | Ballot Measure Challenges Before Placed on Ballot | YES

137 (SCR1044) | Judicial Retention of Judges No Elections Judicial Review Commission | YES

138 (SCR1040)
| Tipped Workers Protection Act: protected tipped minimum wage | YES
311 (SCR1006) | $250K State Benefit 1st Responders | YES
312 (HCR2033) | Property Tax Nuisance Enforcement: allows property owners to apply for a property tax refund if a municipality doesn’t enforce nuisance laws | YES
313 (SCR1021) | Sex Trafficking Natural Life Imprisonment | YES
314 (HCR2060) | Border Bill- Lawful Ports of Entry/Fentanyl | YES
315 (SCR1012) | Legislative Regulatory Costs: requires legislative approval of certain regulations | YES

Since the Republicans still have the majority between the House and Senate, we were able to block many bad bills that would have raised your taxes and increased regulations on small businesses.

Yesterday, Arizona’s U.S. Senator Mark Kelly tweeted out his support for 19 state legislative candidates, including my opponent. In his tweet he explicitly said to support Democrats like my opponent because “these candidates can make the difference and give Governor Hobbs everything.”

If Mark Kelly and Katie Hobbs get their wish in November, the Democrats will dismantle all Arizona’s robust school choice programs on day one, including charter schools, scholarship tax credits, and the widely popular ESA program. The Democrats want to ensure kids are relegated to their zip-code assigned school.

Instead, we need to continue raising the standards, hold educators accountable, so all types of schools both public and provide can compete for our kids.

If you have been reading my emails for the past year, I also have mentioned how the Democrats want to repeal our state’s Right to Work protections in our Constitution. In addition, they want to drastically increase our minimum wage laws that will push many workers out of a job and continue to drive up costs on small businesses who are already struggling under Bidenomics.

My Democratic opponent supports both repealing our Right to Work laws and further raising our minimum wage laws.

My Democrat opponent is a radical extremist. She voted against legislation that wouldn’t tax worker's tips (Prop. 138), secure our border (Prop. 314), or protect minor children from sex trafficking (Prop. 313). Even the current Vice President, Kamala Harris is now saying like Trump has been saying for the past month or so that she would also support Congressman Massie's bill not to tax tips. Yet, my Democrat opponent says NO.

I hope you will join the Bolick Brigade as we push through these final months of this important election. Can you help us write [post](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=18cf5f9538&e=a7ab36849c)[cards](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d0df83b375&e=a7ab36849c) into our district? If you live in my district, will you display a [yard sign](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1bc15fac4c&e=a7ab36849c) in support of my candidacy? Can you [host](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7542f38629&e=a7ab36849c) a fundraiser or [donate](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=973adf807c&e=a7ab36849c) to our campaign? The future of our state depends on you.

I look forward to continuing to work for you.

Best,
Shawnna

Hi Friend,
I wanted to take a moment to share with you my public statement on the current situation in my country of origin, Bangladesh, in case you missed it elsewhere.
In solidarity,
Nina
------
08/12/2024 Statement from Dr. Nina Ahmad, Philadelphia City Councilmember at Large
As an elected official of the City of Philadelphia, I believe in focusing my public comments on issues directly affecting our residents. However, this ongoing crisis in Bangladesh concerns my country of origin, and I am compelled to express that I am deeply troubled and saddened by tragic events unfolding in Bangladesh.
As I understand it, Bangladesh was plunged into instability and widespread uncertainty about the country’s future after several weeks of violent and deadly protests between Bangladeshi students and police forces. The government cracked down with disproportionate force on students protesting a quota system that allocates up to 30 percent of government jobs for relatives of veterans that fought in the country’s war of independence in 1971. I am shocked and appalled that Bangladeshi authorities killed about 400 people and injured thousands more and shut down internet and mobile services across Bangladesh!
Following the departure of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, the interim Prime Minister, Nobel Laureate Mohammed Yunus, has been appointed to lead a peaceful transition of power and restore stability across the country as the new government takes office.
One of the enduring attributes of Bangladesh has been religious pluralism, even though the majority of the population is Muslim. I am hearing very troubling reports of anti-Hindu violence as well as targeting of secular progressive thought leaders in addition to the pervasive lawlessness throughout. It is critical that the rule of law is restored with promotion of democracy, and protection of human rights. As he leads the nation toward free and fair elections, Prime Minister Yunus must put an end to the persistent violence and restore order so the people of Bangladesh can look ahead to a democratic future.
I extend my deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those killed, and best wishes for the recovery of the injured. Our Bangladeshi American communities stateside are very worried about the upheaval in our country of origin.
Having survived the bloody war of Liberation of Bangladesh and experienced the post-war chaos, I deeply empathize with all who are picking up the pieces to restore peace and order in Bangladesh. I have seen the resilience and grit of the people of Bangladesh, and I am sure Bangladesh will emerge stronger from this crisis, with democracy intact and civil society restored.

Fellow American,

In times like these, we need leaders who have truly answered the call to serve. **As someone born and raised in Stockton in a proud military family, I didn’t just talk about service – _I lived it._**

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001, trained at the military police academy, and was honored to be recruited by the White House to serve on Marine One, directly supporting the President of the United States amidst some of the most challenging times in our nation's history.

_**My commitment to this nation goes beyond words – I’ve walked the walk, defending the very freedoms we hold dear.**_ My service was genuine and unwavering – something we can’t say for everyone in politics today.
