First I want to thank my readers who came out and voted for Dr. Goldstein. You were crucial to his victory. And for those who voted for Bob MacGuffie, Michael's opponent, thank you for voting.
The turn out was quite low. Only 7% of registered Republicans voted. This made for an nail biter. As soon as the polls closed, initial returns gave Goldstein an 8-point lead with 11% of the vote. But as more towns submitted their results, the race tied and with 50% of the vote in; MacGuffie was actually ahead slightly.

But then Goldstein's home town of Greenwich came through giving him 79% of their votes and Goldstein a 15% lead.
MacGuffie won some smaller towns and took 65% of his home town of Fairfield. But the turn out percentage Fairfield was less than Greenwich, allowing Goldstein a 6% victory.
**Here is Dr. Goldstein 's letter thanking the voters and those who helped him win while acknowledging Bob MacGuffie as a worthy opponent:**
Yesterday's victory at the polls was one for the people. In politics, there are parties and there are people. Yesterday was a demonstration that people matter and We The People matter. I'm in this race to Heal Connecticut and take back our country. I'm also in it to Put a Doctor in the House to solve a healthcare crisis and so many other issues that affect everyone.

We expected lower turnout, but turnout was even lower than we expected. If you're ever asking yourself, does your vote count? I'm here to tell everyone that every vote matters and it mattered incredibly to us yesterday.

We were the underdog. This was as they say a Rocky story for the ages. This journey began two years ago since we lost as a no name candidate and we have been fighting ever since.

I want to thank my opponent, Bob Macguffie, as this was a primary that tested everything. He was a worthy adversary and we took this 12 rounds to the scorecard. We both fought fair knowing that we would work collaboratively to take on Mr. Himes. Bob has extensive knowledge on my opponent this November. This race was not about either one of us; it was about strengthening the effort to take it to Mr. Himes and honing the message and delivery of that message to the people. The message is honed and our collective resolve is strengthened. Bob and I are both fighters; we have different styles but I think we can figure out some good combinations to land the winning hits this November.

I want to thank everyone who came out and volunteered and especially want to thank my hometown of Greenwich where we picked up 80% of the votes. The town rallied behind me from Fred Camillo and Lauren Rabin, Senator Ryan Fazio, the Greenwich Republican leadership and to all of those that made the calls, worked the polls, wrote letters, sent emails and did not let the dog days of summer serve as an excuse.

A special thanks goes out to the 151st district where we kicked off this campaign and to State Rep candidate Tod Laudonia, Joe Montanaro and Gail Laurdisen who crushed the district and helped garner enough votes to give us a buffer. We also had help from Tina Courpas, a State Rep candidate in the 149th.

I also want to thank Oxford First Selectman George Temple and Selectmen Arnie Jensen. Our politicking at the recycling center and their endorsement led to a commanding lead in Oxford. Mayor Lauretti in Shelton and his endorsement also gave us the lead in Shelton. Tom O'Dea, and the Stamford Republicans and State Rep candidates Olga Anastos, James Malerba and Rudy Settimi helped us take Stamford and New Canaan. State Senator Harding was also instrumental as well.

There's so many others I want to thank and all of those who believed in us and put their neck on the line to endorse a challenger candidate. The list of endorsements is extensive but every one of them helped in different ways. We had support from outside of Connecticut from the Medical Society of the State of New York and the New York Young Republican Club. We had the support of Connecticut's Law Enforcement with the Fraternal Order of Police.

I want to thank my supportive family, my wife Belle, my sons Stephen and Jonathan for being there and encouraging me to fight. My son and campaign manager, Jonathan, deserves a special thanks for doing the work behind the scenes to develop and deploy a strategy that helped me win yesterday. He made some last minute adjustments on our focus to get out the vote which paid off and he worked the polls till close picking up every vote he could. Dr. Joseph Bentivegna was instrumental in the campaign getting the message out and working on the campaign and he and Jonathan were instrumental in getting our message out to over 30,000 people.

We look forward to working with Matt Corey and congratulate him on his victory. We also want to express gratitude to Gerry Smith and his team as we campaigned with both of these candidates over the past few months and have a camaraderie outside of campaigning. The father son duo of Gerry and Ben Smith with the father and son duo of me and my son Jonathan on the trail was a blast and none of this stops.

Now the work begins and we will be taking it to the streets and the people even more now that we are in a general election. Our republican base turned out but this is all about getting to everyone as it's about the better message and the better solutions which we know we have.

I thank everyone for their continued support in time, energy and resources.

Dr. Michael Goldstein

Bob and I are both fighters; we have different styles but I think we can figure out some good combinations to land the winning hits this November. I want to thank everyone who came out and volunteered and especially want to thank my hometown of Greenwich where we picked up 80% of the votes. The town rallied behind me from Fred Camillo and Lauren Rabin, Senator Ryan Fazio, the Greenwich Republican leadership and to all of those that made the calls, worked the polls, wrote letters, sent emails and did not let the dog days of summer serve as an excuse. A special thanks goes out to the 151st district where we kicked off this campaign and to State Rep candidate Tod Laudonia, Joe Montanaro and Gail Laurdisen who crushed the district and helped garner enough votes to give us a buffer. We also had help from Tina Courpas, a State Rep candidate in the 149th. I also want to thank Oxford First Selectman George Temple and Selectmen Arnie Jensen. Our politicking at the recycling center and their endorsement led to a commanding lead in Oxford. Mayor Lauretti in Shelton and his endorsement also gave us the lead in Shelton. Tom O'Dea, and the Stamford Republicans and State Rep candidates Olga Anastos, James Malerba and Rudy Settimi helped us take Stamford and New Canaan. State Senator Harding was also instrumental as well. There's so many others I want to thank and all of those who believed in us and put their neck on the line to endorse a challenger candidate. The list of endorsements is extensive but every one of them helped in different ways. We had support from outside of Connecticut from the Medical Society of the State of New York and the New York Young Republican Club. We had the support of Connecticut's Law Enforcement with the Fraternal Order of Police. I want to thank my supportive family, my wife Belle, my sons Stephen and Jonathan for being there and encouraging me to fight. My son and campaign manager, Jonathan, deserves a special thanks for doing the work behind the scenes to develop and deploy a strategy that helped me win yesterday. He made some last minute adjustments on our focus to get out the vote which paid off and he worked the polls till close picking up every vote he could. Dr. Joseph Bentivegna was instrumental in the campaign getting the message out and working on the campaign and he and Jonathan were instrumental in getting our message out to over 30,000 people. We look forward to working with Matt Corey and congratulate him on his victory. We also want to express gratitude to Gerry Smith and his team as we campaigned with both of these candidates over the past few months and have a camaraderie outside of campaigning. The father son duo of Gerry and Ben Smith with the father and son duo of me and my son Jonathan on the trail was a blast and none of this stops. Now the work begins and we will be taking it to the streets and the people even more now that we are in a general election. Our republican base turned out but this is all about getting to everyone as it's about the better message and the better solutions which we know we have. I thank everyone for their continued support in time, energy and resources. | Dear Friend,
Right now, the news is dominated by what’s happening in the Presidential Race. Meanwhile, mainstream media outlets would like us to forget what’s happening to our ally Israel.
---
[](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=95e176477a&e=91a702298f)
| As you read this email, Israel is under threat from being attacked by Hamas, Hezbollah, and now Iran. This is an incredibly dangerous turning point in the ongoing battle happening in the region, and one that could damage Israel and the millions who live there.

The United States has an obligation to not only defend our allies, but stand against all acts of terrorism. This is why we cannot turn our backs on Israel, and we can’t let news like this get drowned into just another headline.

Democrats like Stever Horsford have refused to acknowledge the peril Israel is in, and has refused to support policies that would send resources and funding to help Israel as it continues to defend itself from attacks from Terrorists groups, and now Tehran.

If you agree with me that we need to stand up for Israel, then sign your name today and join me in the fight for Western ideals and freedoms.

clean_body: We need to support our ally | | | | | | | | Dear Friend, Right now, the news is dominated by what’s happening in the Presidential Race. Meanwhile, mainstream media outlets would like us to forget what’s happening to our ally Israel. | As you read this email, Israel is under threat from being attacked by Hamas, Hezbollah, and now Iran. This is an incredibly dangerous turning point in the ongoing battle happening in the region, and one that could damage Israel and the millions who live there. The United States has an obligation to not only defend our allies, but stand against all acts of terrorism. This is why we cannot turn our backs on Israel, and we can’t let news like this get drowned into just another headline. Democrats like Stever Horsford have refused to acknowledge the peril Israel is in, and has refused to support policies that would send resources and funding to help Israel as it continues to defend itself from attacks from Terrorists groups, and now Tehran. If you agree with me that we need to stand up for Israel, then sign your name today and join me in the fight for Western ideals and freedoms. | Thanks for reading, John Lee | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 John Lee for Congress. Team — Tomorrow is the halfway point of the final fundraising quarter before the election. What that means for our campaign in the near term: In just 45 days, we’ll close the books on the quarter and report our fundraising numbers to the FEC. **Betsy DeVos.**

If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in to my campaign and Defeat Republicans, please use this link to give:

And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back — and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.

So what does that mean?

As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.

And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.

The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.

Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election.

They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.

On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.

What more must Donald Trump do to make clear his anti-immigration stance is focused on one thing and one thing only--advancing white supremacy--and how much longer will legacy media remain complicit? Donald Trump's campaign in general, and against immigrants in particular, is rooted in and fueled by white supremacy. And the receipts make this point irrefutable. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc5f9b95-ff25-41ad-a08d-e5663fb76522?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Donald Trump, an anti-immigrant racist, appears on CNN
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147669809&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3NjY5ODA5LCJpYXQiOjE3MjM2NjMzODMsImV4cCI6MTcyNjI1NTM4MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.LibTCG08rYsTEzZD9HNxfX7S62b9KTwUBEvcQ1qpMCw)
You may have seen the Trump campaign's latest racist anti-immigrant tweet. It compares two neighborhoods--one allegedly under his administration and the other under Kamala Harris. The imagery suggested that Black people, when not under his control, are inherently disorderly and dangerous, while communities otherwise are patriotic. This isn't just a dog whistle; it's a foghorn of white supremacy designed to incite fear and hatred.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/731babc2-aa9a-42c4-8cc4-291704e62f43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And this isn't an isolated incident either. It's the latest in Trump's lifelong hatred of non-white immigrants, a view he's successfully weaponized to rally a racist base. And this racism played out loud and clear in Trump's Twitter spaces exchange with Musk. They painted immigrants, particularly undocumented immigrants, as criminals and a threat to the country--a narrative that is not only false but deeply hypocritical. Here are at least four absurd claims made by Trump and Musk we need to debunk.
## Claim 1: Immigrants increase crime
**Fact:** False. In reality, immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have lower crime rates than native-born U.S. citizens. This has been consistently documented over not just decades, but over centuries. A Northwestern University study looked at [data going back to 1870 and found](https://substack.com/redirect/26927898-f03b-4b53-bbf1-fc1f9d7fed7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Using incarceration rates as a proxy for crime, a team of economists analyzed 150 years of U.S. Census data and found immigrants were consistently less likely to be incarcerated than people born in the U.S. They also found beginning in 1960, the incarceration gap widened such that immigrants today are 60% less likely to be incarcerated than the U.S.-born. "Our study shows that since 1870, it has never been the case that immigrants as a group have been more incarcerated than the U.S.-born," Jacome said.
In reality, the more immigrants you have in your neighborhood, the statistically lower the crime rate is in your neighborhood. Yet, Trump and his allies perpetuate the myth that immigrants are inherently criminal, feeding into a narrative of xenophobia and racism that has long been a cornerstone of his political strategy.
## Claim 2: Undocumented immigrants are, by definition, criminals
**Fact:** False. In reality, the rhetoric that undocumented immigrants are "criminals" simply by virtue of being undocumented is misleading and disingenuous. Crossing the border without proper documentation is a civil violation, not a criminal one. It's comparable to receiving a parking ticket or speeding ticket--a misdemeanor, not a felony. Moreover, the process to apply for asylum--which is a legal act protected by U.S. and international law--necessarily requires crossing the border without documentation before applying. Asylum is legal immigration, and undocumented immigration is not a criminal act. Yet, Trump's campaign ignores these facts to instead paint a picture of chaos and danger, exploiting the fears of those who may not know better.

## Claim 3: Undocumented immigrants pour drugs into America
**Fact:** False. In reality, the data is truly staggering at how much drugs are a U.S. citizen problem for which immigrants are being unfairly maligned, and how U.S. policies to restrict documented immigration has exacerbated the drug crisis. Brookings [reports that](https://substack.com/redirect/3dea0964-d3ce-4e63-b25a-cbb1826b9993?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* Annually about 88% of drug trafficking is conducted by U.S. citizens, not by immigrants.
* Out of those arrested by Border Patrol for illegal crossings, only 0.02% were found with any fentanyl. In other words, 99.98% of fentanyl discovered was at ports of entry and the vast majority of traffickers are U.S. citizens.
* Annual deaths from fentanyl doubled between 2019 and 2021--after the U.S. government banned asylum, a policy that did nothing to actually curb the real sources of the problem.

The real solution to America's drug crisis lies in addressing the true sources of the problem, not in vilifying those who are least responsible for it. That means focusing on comprehensive drug policy reform, smarter border management that targets actual traffickers, and a more humane immigration system that reflects the values of justice and fairness. But as Trump's hypocrisy grows, he's opposed the very legislation designed to help advance meaningful border management.
## Claim 4: Immigrants drain the economy
**Fact:** False. In reality, countless studies quantify the immense economic benefit immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, contribute to the U.S. economy. Far from "taking Black jobs," [as Trump claims](https://substack.com/redirect/78b73344-eaab-4cad-bb6a-83e09496ac02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), immigrants ignite the economy and decrease overall unemployment. And while I can cite numerous studies, I'll opt to cite one by the George W. Bush Institute, lest someone accuse me of cherry picking a left leaning organization. The [Bush study concludes](https://substack.com/redirect/9f609ea2-4ea5-486d-8bde-0e24bb6358be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Immigration fuels the economy. When immigrants enter the labor force, they increase the productive capacity of the economy and raise GDP. Their incomes rise, but so do those of natives. It's a phenomenon dubbed the "immigration surplus," and it amounts to $36 to $72 billion per year.
But what about undocumented immigrants? Surely they're a drain on the American system, right? Nope. The Institute of Taxation and Economic Policy ("ITEP") reports a shocking fact that no sane person could argue is bad for the economy. [ITEP concludes](https://substack.com/redirect/1b1a10ca-68fd-4b25-aafa-d087206f5660?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Undocumented immigrants paid $96.7 billion in federal, state, and local taxes in 2022. Most of that amount, $59.4 billion, was paid to the federal government while the remaining $37.3 billion was paid to state and local governments.
For perspective, undocumented immigrants pay more in taxes than the entire GDP of at least 10 U.S. states. These are taxes they pay towards our Medicare, Medicaid, and social service programs, for which they receive no benefit whatsoever. That's also more in taxes annually than Musk or Trump will ever pay in a lifetime. And thus the hypocrisy of it all.

## Hypocrisy, hypocrisy, hypocrisy
Even beyond the misinformation, I scratched my head as I heard Trump and Musk's hypocrisy on immigration. The mind numbing idea that Donald Trump, a convicted felon, is fear-mongering about immigrant crime rates while embodying the very criminality he claims to detest. No thought given to the fact that two of Trump's wives are immigrants, including Melania who--by Trump's own definition--[was an illegal immigrant herself](https://substack.com/redirect/4aae3ae4-bfbc-421d-9db1-ad924f107600?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Likewise, Elon Musk is himself an immigrant. And while not a convicted felon like Trump, Musk is also credibly accused of [violating campaign finance laws in Michigan](https://substack.com/redirect/a5a36a06-fb0a-498a-91a1-f18479e3abd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and is credibly accused of [violating campaign finance laws in donating to Trump's campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/6ce171e2-51d3-4e6c-afed-dfdbeaa4677f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But perhaps even worse, there is credible evidence that at one point [Elon Musk was also an undocumented immigrant](https://substack.com/redirect/0e8ea6e2-c260-4aef-9503-9c8838a78cb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) himself, an "illegal" by his own admission. You can watch the short clip below from 2013, [where Musk's brother admits they were both "illegal immigrants.](https://substack.com/redirect/13543c24-6d14-4c7b-96c7-8bd3442b23a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2e9bee1e-9c40-47d2-bfee-8bffd4d8c1f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
By his own admission, Musk was an "illegal immigrant" illegally sleeping at the office (i.e. homeless) and didn't even have a car (i.e. low income). Yet now Musk seems to have a short term memory as he proudly paints the caricature of all immigrants, particularly undocumented immigrants, as here illegally and an economic burden on society.
Finally, far from proposing a meaningful solution, Trump has actively [sabotaged efforts to create a functional immigration system](https://substack.com/redirect/8bb73b38-08ae-4149-b929-a88d9f212faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He deliberately killed a bipartisan immigration bill that could have addressed many of the issues he claims to care about. Trump isn't interested in solutions. His goal is to keep the immigration issue alive as a political weapon, using it to rally his base and deepen divisions within the country. It's not about policy; it's about power.
## In Conclusion
The media's role in this situation is crucial. For too long, legacy media outlets have been reluctant to call out Trump's white supremacy for what it is. When a politician uses race and ethnicity as weapons to divide and conquer, it's not just politics as usual; it's an existential threat to the very fabric of our society.
The media must step up. They need to stop treating Trump's rhetoric as merely controversial or provocative and start labeling it for what it is: white supremacist propaganda. This is not about partisanship; it's about truth. Legacy media must stop being complicit in Trump's blatant white supremacy. They have a duty to inform the public, to expose lies, and to hold those in power accountable for their words and actions. Trump's campaign is not just another political movement; it's a calculated attempt to sow discord and inflame racial tensions for political gain.
Only by confronting this white supremacy head-on can we hope to build a more just and equitable society. Otherwise, we risk devolving into fascism, and legacy media will be complicit in its own demise.

body:

#
Peter —
Donald Trump and his campaign just attacked Tim Walz again, accusing him of never holding down a “Real Job” in his entire life. These are not “Real Jobs” according to Trump’s official campaign spokesperson:
National Guardsman
Farmer
Factory Worker
Teacher
Coach

We’re firing back. From Max Rose, Afghanistan Veteran and Senior Advisor to VoteVets:
_“It’s not a surprise that a candidate who called our Troops and fallen “Suckers and Losers” likes to crap all over military service. It’s impossible for them to see anyone selflessly serving as having a “real job.” To them, the only “real job” is screwing contractors out of money they’re owed, to line their own pockets. This comment from Donald Trump’s campaign reeks of the very worst kind of elitism. Troops, Veterans and workers all deserve better than that in the White House.”_
You’ve probably held down a few “Real Jobs” — and we’d like to hear about them.
Are you a Veteran? Or a teacher? A farmer, a factory worker? Maybe all of the above, or none at all. Either way, let us know.

Peter, For years, I have been saying that MAGA Republicans’ obsession with rolling back reproductive freedom and banning abortion has nothing to do with being “pro-life” or promoting “state’s rights.” Instead, it’s all about interfering with our bodily autonomy and controlling womens’ bodies. **And there is no greater personification of this dangerous ideology than JD Vance — Donald Trump’s vice presidential running mate.**
* He openly supports a nationwide ban on abortion, with no exceptions for rape or incest — horrific circumstances that he has called “inconvenient.”
* He has called for a “federal solution” for people seeking travel to access lifesaving reproductive health care.
* He has outrageously claimed that the Democratic party is controlled by “childless cat ladies” and that the votes of people without children should count less than those who do.
* He has said that people who don’t have children are “sociopathic,” “psychotic,” and “deranged” — despite opposing protections for IVF for parents who want to start a family.

It’s abundantly clear — Donald Trump, JD Vance, and MAGA Republicans want to control our bodies and decimate reproductive freedom. **And we must stop them.** [**So please, chip in before tomorrow’s mid-month deadline to help me protect our Democratic Senate majority and turn out voters for Vice President Harris this November. # Let's Fix America's Flat Tire
### In November we can change the tire!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Aug 14
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you well.
Recently, I experienced a flat tire and took action to have it repaired. I didn't continue driving on it, understanding that doing so would only cause further damage. This experience got me thinking about our country's current situation.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b9962c5d-4db2-49da-894b-c23a640a572b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Much like driving on a flat tire isn't a viable solution, continuing with the current administration's policies isn't addressing the pressing issues we face. Under the leadership of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, it feels as though we are driving on a flat tire.
That's why I believe it's crucial for us to elect Donald Trump in November. It's time for a change in direction--one that can effectively address our nation's challenges and steer us towards a brighter future.
Let's work together to get America back on track and ensure we're not just managing but thriving.
Best regards,

Hey there,
**My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska.**
I know what you’re thinking. I get a lot of eye rolls when I say the word Nebraska and tell people that I’m running against a Republican. A lot of people don’t think we can win against a two-term incumbent who has an (R) next to her name. But give me the chance to explain why they’re wrong.
The people of Nebraska are ready for change. **Three new polls show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer – and in one poll, I am even LEADING by 2 points! Seriously.**
Nebraskans are fed up with Washington. Both parties – Democrats and Republicans – are full of too many people that have been bought and paid for by corporations and billionaires. The Republicans don’t look out for blue-collar working people like me, and too many Democrats in DC don’t seem to understand rural America anymore.
I’m not rich, and I don’t come from some political dynasty. **I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s _exactly_ why I am.**
I am a proud card-carrying steamfitter and mechanic. I was president of my local union before I got fired for leading a strike that saved 500 middle-class jobs in Nebraska. I served in the United States Navy and joined the National Guard to help pay for college before I had to drop out so I could keep food on the table for my family.
There’s nobody like me in the Senate. But with your help, I believe we can win and finally elect a senator whose collars are blue. And these new polls showing me in the lead prove it.
I don’t have corporate PACs writing me hundreds of thousands of dollars in checks like my opponent does.**If I’m going to defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate race, I am counting on grassroots donors like you to believe in me and make a donation right now to my campaign:**

I don’t normally share our internal memos, but you’re an essential member of our effort to win the White House this November, and you need to know these things, too. _Here’s the internal update my staff just handed me:_ | **August 14 - INTERNAL MEMO TOPLINES**
**_Peach State Back in Play_**
* A new AARP poll has Trump and Kamala TIED in Georgia.
* Georgia has officially been moved from “Lean Republican” to “TOSS-UP”.
* We’ve identified a massive amount of Georgia voters who stayed home in 2020 that need to be mobilized to vote.

---

**Mel Manuel For US Congress**
---
Friend - At 32, I faced a life-changing challenge: I became pregnant despite using a copper IUD, one of the most reliable forms of contraception available. Though 99% effective, I was part of the unfortunate 1%. The IUD was properly in place, but as we know, no birth control is foolproof. At the time, I was living in extreme poverty with my 5-year-old daughter in New Orleans, struggling to make ends meet as a tour guide. My spouse, a Venezuelans with Spanish citizenship, was battling multiple sclerosis and could only visit the country sporadically. The prospect of bringing another child into the world under such circumstances was overwhelming. It would have been financially devastating and would have made it nearly impossible to care for the child I was already struggling to support. I made the difficult decision to terminate the unplanned pregnancy, opting for a medical abortion at a clinic in New Orleans- a clinic that no longer exists due to Louisiana's total abortion ban. The relied I felt afterward confirmed that I made the right choice for myself and my family.

This experience deeply influence my decision to run for Congress and to serve as the Director of Operations for the Louisiana Abortion Fund.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsYnR9WKQjfGn170MX_JqHzR3E6o_zvby7h7TGqr7bI_G4fWKwfj-L5EbfoqFl5uiRwOLlK2GO7GDBrir8UbAd1LkZnXFMhGCEoEnbhtG8aY5X-1M1zSzu1gC4ucAukvGynjMNtTTj00I_09ygj89AajeGoZLoBlpuhTQ3M_ZHneItpuyMEmElvYuN919mHj58VbKOm7CQKLKSH-wAD80HKtmMArkpp0RSLwquZfHgoeZzqcLnWt46YgTOsmfh2XVIYNcg9dhr9NEFksZ7HqAmIPm_hV5o8U5lulXw8ROWdyOrLJkRLm1YpnfJPLJjNmCY/48w/8U_b3sSNQwm9zUw7XNohDA/h1/h001.hLhHZJjaZ3J73FmwZi_3b5okttwOp-VkZn6FrVceLfg)
---
_Me with my daughter in 2012._
---
For the past two years, we've lived in a post-Roe world, and I've witnessed firsthand the soul-crushing consequences of this sinister decision. In Louisiana, where abortion is completely banned and even abortion pills are criminalized, the situation is dire.

At the Louisiana Abortion Fund, we manage a hotline to provide pregnant individuals in the Gulf South with information and financial assistance to obtain safe abortions in states where it's still legal. However, as more states enact bans and restrictive laws, the demands for abortions-and the cost of obtaining them-continues to rise. This increased demand is making it incredibly difficult for funds like ours to meet the needs of everyone who calls.

I believe that everyone should have access to safe and legal abortion care, but in the world we live in now, that's not the reality.

I am running for Congress to fight for the women in Louisiana and across the United States who are being pushed into impossible situations. **My opponent, Steve Scalise, is an anti-abortion extremist who, as Majority Leader of the House, will use his power to push for a national abortion ban. if he succeeds, countless lives will be at risk.** [**This is a life-or-death fight, and I need your support to unseat him and protect our right to reproductive freedom. Can I count on you to join us by making a contribution, no matter the amount? Every dollar helps us push back and protect the rights of women across the country.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsYnR9WKQjfGn170MX_JqHzR3E6o_zvby7h7TGqr7bI_G4fWKwfj-L5EbfoqFl5uiSup3dyD0pI5_XdST8afGRDDwYINA5m4kLj1MssptJ_fzA3IC4_6YqZyVVAFWB4WV1GKH_z9csaZRhwxU7HG36eWLLvf3t86r6ogON-jmbW_jIJM-Rol2IWG5VBpyV8jBcDLylb_gyo537kdK_fyBHKEjJkFdMubYGCJ0zQb1u7sULWjoADAIo4co7wJePB1mhAfemDHjF2JUnuktfgrgo3pXFB62rqRXMLTTniK_U7ygy3aZN9ks8K6zOhMQk9Uks/48w/8U_b3sSNQwm9zUw7XNohDA/h2/h001.kvxEcdHKKKOKz3UtBeg_wxvzii7Nv-sEQTpXTi957vI)

clean_body: I became pregnant despite using a copper IUD. Though 99% effective, I was part of the unfortunate 1% | | Mel Manuel For US Congress Friend - At 32, I faced a life-changing challenge: I became pregnant despite using a copper IUD, one of the most reliable forms of contraception available. Though 99% effective, I was part of the unfortunate 1%. The IUD was properly in place, but as we know, no birth control is foolproof. At the time, I was living in extreme poverty with my 5-year-old daughter in New Orleans, struggling to make ends meet as a tour guide. My spouse, a Venezuelans with Spanish citizenship, was battling multiple sclerosis and could only visit the country sporadically. The prospect of bringing another child into the world under such circumstances was overwhelming. It would have been financially devastating and would have made it nearly impossible to care for the child I was already struggling to support. I made the difficult decision to terminate the unplanned pregnancy, opting for a medical abortion at a clinic in New Orleans- a clinic that no longer exists due to Louisiana's total abortion ban. The relied I felt afterward confirmed that I made the right choice for myself and my family. This experience deeply influence my decision to run for Congress and to serve as the Director of Operations for the Louisiana Abortion Fund. | Me with my daughter in 2012. For the past two years, we've lived in a post-Roe world, and I've witnessed firsthand the soul-crushing consequences of this sinister decision. In Louisiana, where abortion is completely banned and even abortion pills are criminalized, the situation is dire. At the Louisiana Abortion Fund, we manage a hotline to provide pregnant individuals in the Gulf South with information and financial assistance to obtain safe abortions in states where it's still legal. However, as more states enact bans and restrictive laws, the demands for abortions-and the cost of obtaining them-continues to rise. This increased demand is making it incredibly difficult for funds like ours to meet the needs of everyone who calls. I believe that everyone should have access to safe and legal abortion care, but in the world we live in now, that's not the reality. I am running for Congress to fight for the women in Louisiana and across the United States who are being pushed into impossible situations. My opponent, Steve Scalise, is an anti-abortion extremist who, as Majority Leader of the House, will use his power to push for a national abortion ban. if he succeeds, countless lives will be at risk. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Thank you for standing with us in this crucial battle. Nancy Dahlstrom vs Mary Peltola: A Battle of Records

ANCHORAGE, AK - Alaskans are already heading to the polls to cast their
votes for Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom but, as with every election,
there are voters still on the fence.

Dahlstrom is the best conservative candidate in the race. President
Donald J. Trump knows it, as do House Speaker Mike Johnson and Governor
Mike Dunleavy. That's why they've all endorsed her for the job. They
know that Dahlstrom's experience as lieutenant governor alone makes her
a power player at the table in Washington. Combine that with her time
as Alaska's commissioner of the Department of Corrections and several
terms in the state legislature, and you have a true triple-threat.

Meanwhile, the Democrats are running, yet again, a progressive in
moderate clothing: Mary Peltola. Peltola has been a rubber stamp for
the dangerous Biden-Harris-Walz agenda crippling Alaskans' wallets, she
has helped Joe Biden stifle Alaska's energy production, she voted
against pro-Alaska bills like the Lower Energy Costs Act, and now she
thinks that staying away from Kamala Harris will absolve her of the
policies she's supported.

"The verdict is clear: only Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom has the
pro-Alaska, pro-America record to truly represent her great state in
Congress," Dahlstrom campaign manager Justine Jaenisch said in a
statement. "Mary Peltola can try to pretend she's a moderate, she can
try to keep her distance from Kamala Harris and Tim Walz as she grasps
to save her job. But she can't escape the reality that her tenure in
the House will be defined by one word: short."

| | Today marks the 89th anniversary of the creation of Social Security. On this day in 1935, the monumental 37-page Social Security Act was signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt. And now, most Americans do not remember a time before Social Security. In the years since its adoption, the landmark legislation evolved into a euphemism for retirement benefits. But it is more than just a monthly check for retirees — **it is a safety net for**** _everyone_****that provides financial stability and peace of mind throughout life.** Social Security includes: **Retirement Security:** The most common connotation of Social Security is the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in your golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. **Disability Protection:** Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. **Survivor Benefits:** Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. **Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital.** But Social Security and its beneficiaries are vulnerable right now. Year after year, my Republican colleagues in Congress release their budget with catastrophic cuts to important programs like Social Security. And each time, I am disheartened to see that they are looking to further cut funding to critical social safety nets like Social Security. They said it themselves in the budget introduction this year: **"The RSC Budget is more than just a financial statement. It is a statement of priorities."** Their priorities are misaligned with what our communities need. **To me, it is plain and simple: hardworking folks paid into Social Security, and it is not a handout.** I oppose the privatization of Social Security and have sponsored "Scrap the Cap" legislation, which would no longer exempt income earned above $147,000 from Social Security taxes to strengthen the Social Security fund. **Social Security demonstrates our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for**** _all_****, regardless of their socioeconomic status.** And as a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security, I am redoubling my efforts to fortify these protections. Disability Protection: Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. Survivor Benefits: Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital. But Social Security and its beneficiaries are vulnerable right now. Year after year, my Republican colleagues in Congress release their budget with catastrophic cuts to important programs like Social Security. And each time, I am disheartened to see that they are looking to further cut funding to critical social safety nets like Social Security. They said it themselves in the budget introduction this year: "The RSC Budget is more than just a financial statement. It is a statement of priorities." Their priorities are misaligned with what our communities need. To me, it is plain and simple: hardworking folks paid into Social Security, and it is not a handout. I oppose the privatization of Social Security and have sponsored "Scrap the Cap" legislation, which would no longer exempt income earned above $147,000 from Social Security taxes to strengthen the Social Security fund. Social Security demonstrates our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for all, regardless of their socioeconomic status. And as a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security, I am redoubling my efforts to fortify these protections. = It is not just about us. It is about future generations, too. Together, we can ensure that Social Security remains a rock-solid foundation for all Americans. # Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
---
|
---
|
## Note from The Host Committee
---
| We are **less than a week** away from the Democratic National Convention!
This will be the final edition of Host Committee Happenings before the DNC. Thank you to everyone who has followed along and supported the work of the Chicago 2024 Host Committee.
The moment is finally here and Chicago is ready!
---
|
---
|
## Neighborhood Engagement Milestone
---
| On Monday, the Chicago 2024 Host Committee [announced](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=20d31205f1&e=e789b9d47e) the successful engagement of all 77 community areas in Chicago. This moment signifies a major milestone in the Host Committee’s years-long effort to ensure that the 2024 Democratic National Convention is inclusive, impactful, and beneficial to every corner of the city.
---
| In celebration of this milestone, the Host Committee also announced a first-of-its-kind initiative for delegates and convention visitors to tour historic community areas in Chicago, including **Bronzeville, Woodlawn, Pilsen, Little Village, North Lawndale, Garfield Park, Roseland** , and **Pullman**. Co-sponsored by Illinois Senator **Tammy Duckworth** and led by Chicago Urban Historian **Shermann “Dilla” Thomas** , these tours will explore underrepresented neighborhoods in Chicago, allowing participants to engage with, and discuss the effects of, policymaking decisions in real-time.
To read about the Host Committee’s diverse contracting efforts [click here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=5f10508cac&e=e789b9d47e).
---
|
---
|
## Chicago DNC Pep Rally
---
| On Friday, Host Committee Executive Director **Christy George** joined the **Choose Chicago** team, Illinois Governor **JB Pritzker** , Chief Operating Officer of the City of Chicago**John Roberson** , and partners from around the city for a pep rally at [360 Chicago](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=13ce1e4f3e&e=e789b9d47e) to energize community stakeholders ahead of the DNC!
In partnership with the Choose Chicago Foundation (CCF), the Host Committee announced the sponsoring of [$150,000 in scholarships](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d8bde7e913&e=e789b9d47e) for students in the hospitality industry.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
## Bud Biliken Parade
Last Saturday, members of the Host Committee team marched in the historic **Bud Billiken Parade** , the largest African-American parade in the United States!
---
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d47c5aa51c&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Neighborhood Ads
---
| The Host Committee unveiled a [new ad campaign](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=4ea0fe617e&e=e789b9d47e), “The Future is Built in Chicago”, featuring community leaders from nine neighborhoods in Chicago. The campaign aims to highlight Chicago’s diverse community areas and the working people who reside in them.
The campaign is live on digital billboards and street furniture throughout the city with a special emphasis on high-traffic areas for convention visitors.
Check out the ads below!
---
|
---
|
## DNC Instagram Filters
---
| In preparation for the Democratic National Convention, we have created an instagram filter based on our campaign, “The Future is Built in Chicago”. We highly encourage you to use our filter during the Democratic National Convention and encourage others to engage with our content.
This filter can be used for either pictures or videos, portraying a frame around your face with you as the center of the graphic. You can easily change the colors and fonts by tapping on the screen before taking a picture.
You can access the filter through this [link](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f7c2621174&e=e789b9d47e). We are looking forward to seeing you during the convention!
---
[Instagram Filters](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8049329ef2&e=e789b9d47e)

## Chicago DNC Resources
---
| | | | | | | | | | | The Host Committee’s Resource Guide is now live! Our guide is your one-stop shop for discounts, offers, and city events during convention week. This guide is a great resource not only for convention visitors, but also for locals looking to take advantage of great deals accompanying the DNC.
---
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ef091ff601&e=e789b9d47e)
[DNC Resource Guide](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c394077220&e=e789b9d47e)
| | | | | | | | | | | Be sure to follow our social media for information about more deals as the convention nears. You can follow us on[ Instagram](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=397271ff68&e=e789b9d47e),[ Facebook](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=52c3cacbe0&e=e789b9d47e),[ Linkedin](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0515553f8d&e=e789b9d47e), and[ X](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a3f16b5228&e=e789b9d47e). ## Illinois Youth Press Corps
Today, the Chicago 2024 Host Committee announced that ten high schools from across the state of Illinois will participate in the Illinois Youth Press Corps. More than forty student journalists will be fully credentialed to report on the 2024 Democratic National Convention, making the Illinois Youth Press Corps the most robust youth coverage opportunity in convention history.
The Host Committee worked with the Illinois Journalism Education Association to identify exceptional student journalists across the state and provide them with convention coverage opportunities including inside the United Center and McCormick Place.
---
[Read More Here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=38c59068a2&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Choose Chicago’s DNC Guides
---
| Looking to make plans during the convention? Check out Choose Chicago’s [eleven DNC guides](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fe983086be&e=e789b9d47e) aimed to help visitors discover the vibrancy and diversity of the city. The guides highlight different communities such as LGBTQ+, family friendly, Black culture, Hispanic/Latino culture, and Asian culture as well as insights to music, food and family friendly activities!
---
[Learn More Here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a52065aef6&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Host Committee Pre-Convention Events
---
| This week, three events organized by the Host Committee will be welcoming thousands of convention visitors.
**The Volunteer Appreciation Rally:** Thousands of convention volunteers will gather in Lakeview at the historic Wrigley Field. The rally will be an opportunity for volunteers to receive a briefing on assignment information, meet their fellow volunteers, and get energized for the monumental week ahead.
**The Media Welcome Party** will kick off at Navy Pier with an expected attendance of several thousand members of the international media. Sponsored by the United Association of Union Plumbers and Pipefitters, the Media Welcome Party will be a true showcase of Chicago’s 77 community areas
**Delegate Welcome Party** will welcome thousands of attendees back to Navy Pier for another celebration of Chicago. Sponsored by the National Education Association and the United Association of Union Plumbers and Pipefitters, the event will also feature performances by Chicago guitarists and vocalists.
---
[Read More](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fcbeeffc58&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Community Impact Information
---
| Live near United Center or McCormick Place? We hosted a briefing with Chicago public safety officials which includes everything you need to know about the impact of the DNC.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=65d7c41bea&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| **United Center Briefing**

| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d12674259b&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| **McCormick Place Briefing**

## Getting Around the City During the DNC
---
| Want an easy, sustainable way to get around the city? Chicago has abundant transportation items that include Bikes, e-Bikes, and scooters.**Use discount code: DNC2024**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
[Divvy Bike App](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c4684c056b&e=e789b9d47e)
|
[Lime Scooter App](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=68ca4e984f&e=e789b9d47e)
|
[Spin Scooter App](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8cfa2af02f&e=e789b9d47e)
| **How to use shared bikes and scooters:** Divvy provides pedal bikes, e-bikes, and e-scooters available for rental at hundreds or stations across the entire city. Shared e-scooters can also be rented through Spin and Lime.
**The easiest way to park a shared bike or scooter at the United Center will be to use the valet parking location next to Malcom X College, on W. Jackson Blvd.**
Divvy bikes and e-scooters can be parked at open Divvy stations and at the valet. Divvy e-bikes and e-scooters can also be locked to any bike rack outside the yellow “No Parking Zone.”
Spin and Lime e-scooters can be parked at the valet or locked to any bike rack outside the yellow “No Parking Zone.”
---
|
---
|
## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| Congratulations to **Nathan M.** for being the first to correctly answer last week’s question. The Chicago Stadium and the International Amphitheater are the two venues that have previously hosted multiple DNCs in Chicago.
This week’s question:**Since the first Democratic National Convention in Chicago in 1864, what has been the longest stretch of time without Chicago playing as host to the DNC?**
**Email**[**press@chicago2024.com**](mailto:Press@chicago2024.com?subject=Convention%20Trivia%20Answer&body=null)**with your answer.**
---
|
---
|
## 77 Spotlight
---
| | | | | | | | | | | This week, our spotlights are a trio of neighborhoods close to the happenings of next week’s DNC
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **Grand Boulevard** , located in the historic Bronzeville community, acted as a hub for African-American intellectuals, musicians, artists, and writers from 1870 to 1930s. 📚 [Bronzeville Historical Society](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0b1c9c0d64&e=e789b9d47e) seeks to preserve and educate visitors about the history and lives of African Americans through educational programing.
---
|
---
| 📷 Steve Geer
---
| 🍷 Check out [Bronzeville Winery](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=076646bd55&e=e789b9d47e) for a night-out of speciality drinks, a tasty meal, and delicious desserts!🍿 [Moore Poppin Gourmet Popcorn](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a04674c244&e=e789b9d47e) is known for their cheese, carmel, pecan, and rajun cajun spicy cheese flavors.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| 📷 Patricia Ybara
---
| | **McKinley Park** serves as both a neighborhood and a park. The park offers a swimming pool, artificial turf soccer field, baseball fields, basketball courts, an ice skating rink, a playground and a kiddie pool with a slide!🍺 The [Marz Community Brewing Company](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=254380c5f3&e=e789b9d47e) is a modern event venue that serves locally crafted beers, non-alcoholic drinks, and canned black coffee!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | 🍩 Open 24 hours a day serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, [Huck Finn’s ](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fc038040d3&e=e789b9d47e)restaurant on South Archer is best known for their award-winning donuts.
---
|
---
|
## Vendor Spotlights
---
| [**Mr. Brunch Chicago, LLC,**](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=060e8a0b19&e=e789b9d47e) is a full-service caterer that serves a range of clients from intimate parties to large scale events. During the pandemic, Mr. Brunch pivoted and created a live, online weekly cooking program, “Dinner in 45,” showing the world how to cook everyday meals in less than an hour. A CPS and City Colleges of Chicago-certified vendor, Mr. Brunch Chicago has a staff of cooks, servers and licensed bartenders that have executed events on both a local and national scale.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | [Avlí in the Park](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=42189f3e62&e=e789b9d47e) is a Greek inspired restaurant with three locations in **Lakeshore East** , **Lincoln Park** , and **River North**. Avlí serves greek classics such as chicken souvlaki, monastiraki gyros, and moussaka with seasonal summer drinks. Deals included $10 cocktails from 2:30 - 5:30 pm from Monday to Friday and a three course $25 lunch special menu on weekdays.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Open since 2005, [Carnival restaurant](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e5ce661326&e=e789b9d47e) offers a variety of Latin fusion cuisine. Serving everything from lobster paella to Brazilian Churrasco, the restaurant uses produce from their own rooftop garden and seeks to support local farmers and artisans. During the convention, Carnivale will offer FREE live entertainment, no reservation needed or cover charge! Click [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a6ab9a0033&e=e789b9d47e) for more information.
---
|
---
|
---
|
## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week's staff spotlight is our General Counsel **Joe Sandler**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Joe is no stranger to Democratic Conventions. Joe served as counsel to the DNC for the 1988 convention, general counsel of the DNC and DNCC for the 1996, 2000, 2004, and 2008 conventions, and represented the bid and host committees for the 2012, 2016, 2020, and now the Chicago 2024 Host Committee. When not working for Democratic National Conventions, Joe enjoys listening to music, working out, yoga, traveling. Joe is originally from Baltimore, MD and today resides in Washington DC.
---

# _**Your YDA August Newsletter**_
---
Dear Young Democrats,

Can you feel the excitement in the air? We’re just days away from the Democratic National Convention, and this year is shaping up to be one for the history books. With Kamala Harris leading the charge and Governor Walz stepping into the national spotlight as our Vice Presidential nominee, there’s a renewed sense of energy and purpose in the party. It’s not just about the speeches or the fanfare; it’s about the direction we’re heading as a nation and the impact we can all have together.

This convention is a celebration of our shared values and the hard work that’s brought us here. As we gear up for what’s ahead, staying informed is key. Let’s dive in and stay connected—because together, we’re keeping the momentum going!
---
|
---
# _**Kamala Harris and Tim Walz Are The Democratic Ticket**_
---
|
---
The Young Democrats of America were excited to learn of Vice President Kamala Harris’ decision to select Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her 2024 running mate. Throughout his time in office, Walz has routinely fought to better the lives of Minnesotans— providing universal school meals, paid family leave, red flag gun laws, legalization of marijuana, and environmental protections. In 2023, Walz codified reproductive healthcare as a “fundamental right” in Minnesota by signing the Protect Reproductive Options Act into law. During his time in office, he also signed many LGBTQ+ protection bills into law, including the lifesaving "Trans Refuge" bill. In the words of the Minnesota Young DFL president and national Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama: “Governor Walz has nearly two decades of critical government experience, first as congressman and now as a two term governor who has presided over one of the most consequential and progressive legislative sessions in Minnesota history. His selection sends a clear message that a Harris-Walz administration is ready to deliver for the American people on day one.” We, the Young Democrats of America, could not be more enthusiastic with Vice President Harris’ decision. We look forward to electing Harris and Walz to their respective offices in November 2024. **[See our full statement here.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg466NM2memkqZ2ddc95petzTGjAONPoEsp_2qXKSEgErCRsdC6yi_Bt3F9hP29rXlxynWAojvf_2Gct63L6Z9zeeGnIDT8OOm8_UsHfaLcD_ZSvtGIO8qXFEZNSgcVNoOAAQxwdgxNzyqKLhK2QrmnYfUXAX7uiygZQ4G1OSFPC7JERZ-jXBa7SCNChuFNLmCtZwlrIV8Rn8gFIGA0g3hALQjzu85Sxi4Z1QhE0GzSIXsg/48w/SsidBonWR2SZaqttd_5tKQ/h1/h001.d7PGeyKTLxnN8p2sRAntOTNzGG-6Dt98jPFiiinCqVk)**

clean_body: In August here’s what need to know >>> | | Your YDA August Newsletter Dear Young Democrats, Can you feel the excitement in the air? We’re just days away from the Democratic National Convention, and this year is shaping up to be one for the history books. With Kamala Harris leading the charge and Governor Walz stepping into the national spotlight as our Vice Presidential nominee, there’s a renewed sense of energy and purpose in the party. It’s not just about the speeches or the fanfare; it’s about the direction we’re heading as a nation and the impact we can all have together. This convention is a celebration of our shared values and the hard work that’s brought us here. As we gear up for what’s ahead, staying informed is key. Let’s dive in and stay connected—because together, we’re keeping the momentum going! | Kamala Harris and Tim Walz Are The Democratic Ticket | The Young Democrats of America were excited to learn of Vice President Kamala Harris’ decision to select Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her 2024 running mate. Throughout his time in office, Walz has routinely fought to better the lives of Minnesotans— providing universal school meals, paid family leave, red flag gun laws, legalization of marijuana, and environmental protections. In 2023, Walz codified reproductive healthcare as a “fundamental right” in Minnesota by signing the Protect Reproductive Options Act into law. During his time in office, he also signed many LGBTQ+ protection bills into law, including the lifesaving "Trans Refuge" bill. In the words of the Minnesota Young DFL president and national Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama: “Governor Walz has nearly two decades of critical government experience, first as congressman and now as a two term governor who has presided over one of the most consequential and progressive legislative sessions in Minnesota history. His selection sends a clear message that a Harris-Walz administration is ready to deliver for the American people on day one.” We, the Young Democrats of America, could not be more enthusiastic with Vice President Harris’ decision. We look forward to electing Harris and Walz to their respective offices in November 2024. | Upcoming Events \- August 14 - Honolulu, HI \- August 18 - Chicago, IL \- August 19 - Chicago, IL Democratic National Convention - August 19-22 - Chicago, IL \- August 20 - Chicago, IL \- August 21 - Chicago, IL \- Aug 21 - Online \- August 24 - Maitland, FL \- Norwood, OH \- August 27 - Lincoln, NE \- Sept 20-21 - Chattanooga, TN \- Sept 21 - TBD, CA \- Sept 21 - Las Vegas, NV \- Sept 22 - Kensington, MD \- October 3rd - Trenton, NJ Is there a YDA local, chartered unit or caucus event that should be listed in our next newsletter? | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

I'm reaching out to ask you to split a [_**$10 donation**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90833468/491824502/394907292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-08-14_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBiZTM1OWNhLTg0NWEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dgNYc_YwgLvTZa2ej5OQgnKSDnDFc2854k30gd1FMSU=) between Fight for Progress and Will Rollins’ campaign before his next deadline hits. In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay by sending out bigoted, homophobic campaign mailers in our race.

This was before I'd even come out publicly.

Coming out is an extremely personal moment, so you can imagine my horror finding out I had been outed so publicly -- _and in such a hateful way._

**And you might be familiar with the person who did it -- Ken Calvert, the same Republican that Will Rollins is now running to unseat.**

Calvert blamed “the times” and claims he has since changed, but his attacks on the LGBTQ community haven’t. He voted against the Matthew Shepard hate crimes bill. He voted against gay adoption and voted to keep us out of the military.

**After all these years, I can’t think of a stronger rebuke of Calvert's long-standing, anti-LGBTQ agenda than by replacing him with an openly gay prosecutor like Will who will uphold the law and fight for equal rights.**

name: Jill Stein
subject: OUTRAGEOUS: Another $20B for Israel
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We demand an arms embargo NOW.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=1)
---
Peter,

Three days after I sent the message below, we learned that the Biden-Harris administration just handed Israel ANOTHER $20 BILLION in weapons and military equipment on a silver platter.

That's barely a week after the LAST $3B in armaments the administration shipped over just before Israel demolished a school housing refugees and killed over 100 people – many of them women, children, and elderly.

Genocide apologists are quick to point out that much of this latest “aid package” comes in the form of fighter jets that won’t be delivered for years – but that is precisely the problem.

Right now, the number one provocateur driving us towards a global conflict with nuclear weapons is Israel, and the Biden-Harris administration has just recommitted America to the long-term project of sponsoring their constant escalations.

**If EITHER Harris or Trump is elected this year, Israel is guaranteed to receive this equipment and be given free reign to use it.

[There is only one campaign with a path to the White House this November that will stop this shipment and impose a complete arms embargo against Israel on Day One – and that is ours.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=2)**

Just imagine all the good we could do with that $20B right here at home.

For $20 billion we could completely eradicate homelessness in the U.S.

We could fund universal free school lunches and supplemental meals so that NO child has to learn on an empty stomach.

We could fund a year’s worth of universal pre-K services, providing critical support to working class families who have no access to childcare, and creating countless new job opportunities.

We could fund critical climate initiatives in the most vulnerable communities.

**We could use that $20B to alleviate suffering here at home. Instead we are using it to arm a genocidal apartheid vassal state to commit MORE war crimes.

** Not even the attempted murder of an American citizen is enough to make them alter course. Murtaza Hussain reported yesterday for Drop Site News that Amado Sison, a New Jersey activist protesting the ethnic cleansing campaign now ramping up in the West Bank, was shot and wounded by an Israeli soldier on Friday.

_Importantly: Sison was shot from behind as the protesters were retreating, a common tactic among Israeli Occupation Forces.

_ When they tell you that we have to vote “blue” for peace and democracy, remember that **every single child murdered in Gaza since October 7th was killed with weapons sent by a Democratic president.

[The only way to end this madness is to break free from the twin parties of war and Wall Street and vote Green. I need your support to reach every American who wants to end this genocide and forge a new path rooted in justice for Palestine.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=4 "As Gaza goes we all go") [As Gaza goes we all go](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=4)
---
In solidarity,

Jill

\---------- Forwarded message ---------

From: **Jill Stein** <info@jillstein2024.com>
Date: Sat, Aug 10, 2024
Subject: Israel blew up another school today

Peter,

For the last six weeks, it’s been increasingly difficult to find mainstream news reporting about Israel’s continued campaign of mass murder against the people of Palestine.

Instead, there has been endless and breathless reporting on the palace intrigue of the presidential race – from Joe Biden’s debate performance to Kamala’s coronation, and everything in between.

Every time you see another cable news host cracking jokes about JD Vance and couches, remember that they’re NOT talking about the fact that Israel is still killing Palestinians in Gaza. Every. Single. Day.

Including today.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=5)
---
Just hours ago, **Israel dropped three 2,000-pound bombs supplied by the Biden-Harris administration on the al-Tabin school in Gaza City** , which was functioning as a shelter for displaced Palestinians – including women, children, and the elderly.

The bombs struck as they were engaged in morning prayers. Many who didn’t die in the initial blast were killed instead by the fire that ripped through the building afterwards.

It’s been four months since the Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor estimated that Israel has dropped over 70,000 tons of bombs on Gaza – nearly FOUR TIMES the total bombs the Luftwaffe dropped on London in WW-II.

**It has not stopped – and it will not stop until**** _we stop giving Israel bombs_****.

** The bombs dropped on the al-Tabin school today were **just three of the more than 14,000 MK-84, 2,000-pound bombs Biden has given Netanyahu** since October 7th.

Since Biden dropped out of the presidential race, many activists within the Democratic party who have relentlessly fought for an end to this genocide have cautiously embraced Harris and her candidacy – believing that President Biden won’t stop capitulating to Israel, but a possible President Harris would.

This is her chance to prove it.

**Harris has the power now to pressure Biden for a full arms embargo against Israel – and a permanent ceasefire. If she expects to earn the support of those who oppose this indiscriminate slaughter, she has to answer those demands.

** The signs are not encouraging, however. The latest shipment of MK-84s was part of ANOTHER $3B military “aid package” for Israel authorized by the Biden-Harris administration only days ago – around the same time **Vice President Harris told pro-Palestine protesters in Detroit,****_“I’m speaking now.”

_** We won’t accept another four years of lip service from Democrats who talk about peace while supplying weapons to war criminals and facilitating the extermination of an entire people.

**[For those committed to ending this genocide, there is only one choice this November. Ours is the ONLY anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-planet, pro-worker campaign with a pathway to the White House. Help me get our campaign in front of every voter who supports a ceasefire and lasting peace with justice.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=6)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=7 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=7)
---
Israel’s damnable assault on the al-Tabin school is far from an isolated incident. There are at least 200 documented Israeli air strikes against schools over the last 10 months – a number we are certain is undercounted.

Much like the over 600 strikes against hospitals, aid stations, and first responders, Israel’s continued attacks on schools and refugee shelters are flagrant violations of international law.

By supplying the weapons, we are participating in their war crimes, and we will not allow those responsible to turn a blind eye.

Over 100 people died in today’s bombing on this school. After so many months of relentless bombing, the numbers begin to blur together.

But they are not numbers. They are people. They deserved to live, and we owe them justice.

[**We will not allow the beautiful souls of the Palestinian people to be reduced to rubble and statistics. Stand with me and make this campaign as strong as we can so we can deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace on November 5th.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_aid_pkg_rr&n=8)

As Gaza goes, we all go.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

Peter,

Gabe Vasquez is suddenly trying to convince voters he cares about the illegal immigration crisis he has enabled and supported by visiting the Santa Teresa Port of Entry.

Let’s not be fooled – **this is a political campaign stunt.**

Now that we’re leading Gabe in the latest polls, he’s reading the writing on the wall and changing his tune.

But here’s the truth that he can’t hide from. Gabe Vasquez...

* Voted against the Secure the Border Act.
* Voted against the Laken Riley Act to detain criminal illegal aliens.
* Voted against denouncing Biden-Harris immigration policies.
* Voted against hiring more CBP agents and streamlining the asylum process.
* Voted against deploying improved technology to the southern border.
* Voted against ending catch and release.
* Voted against removing Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas.
* Established ties with an extreme open borders group.
* Said the border crisis is a “non-existent threat."
* Called efforts to secure the border “ill-informed” and “in bad taste.”
* Called to eliminate ICE, claiming it has “no regard for humanity.”
* Said the border wall was built by a “crooked, racist administration.”
* Applauded Biden for halting construction on the wall.
* Called border security a “racist, environmentally destructive, massive waste of money” and “a glorification of xenophobia.”

The truth is that **Gabe Vasquez is _against_ border security**, and no visit to the Port of Entry is going to trick us or the Border Security agents working there otherwise.

We won’t have secure voters until we rid Washington of anti-border security radical politicians like Gabe Vasquez and Kamala Harris.

[PROTECT AMERICA FROM GABE VASQUEZ](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=1217697a25c547f2a6690f17cc422cbc&_e=tS-lNE6jtiTKNWQptb1FBYiHlzfj0mUXo2zBj5jVplUo7fd7HlwpgRhYNDPIR77UVHL3TCwaAa2xI1eC2tRkO14OE5wjjMGVyaeVxT5CsgYHQuyNlyFiPBB-iCDVzv_0KS0sxwy_vwKyZ8K4NY4AABMRi3o5ILaWfglTeidHejwxD17ajTmQjqVPgJ2weEjwZ4STT30BenyXsZCnPmwDchK7Bn2pmm52v0OE6pvMqypwqvYSLo2qI9j9wEBN88emAt27Pz3bzcCxL0Hbpd7wtRinTAs0GsrKQiMYWf6Mvypz_nMjylrjAVfa3hX5kdyPP153PnkHCLelZSKVj8fzJg9RNtdK5ExJT_LFnMvvvcYuaDRn4OzzXSgizzlZOZrC)
With **less than 90 days until the election** and this race still virtually tied, we need every bit of help you can send to defeat Gabe Vasquez.

Can you chip in even just $15 today so we can win in November and secure our borders?

For New Mexico,

Yvette Herrell

body:
Our Republican Party needs these America First Fighters in the US Senate to work with President Trump to rebuild our country after Joe Biden’s destructive term. |
Fellow American,

We are fortunate to have battle-tested conservative leaders running for United States Senate. These brave men have served in combat as members of America's armed forces that secure our nation from foreign threats.

We owe them a debt of gratitude for their service and sacrifice. We can never repay that debt, but we can stand with these brave men as they work to flip four seats and elect a Republican Senate Majority.

We have NO TIME TO LOSE PASSING THE AMERICA FIRST AGENDA.

**Sam Brown, Tim Sheehy, Hung Cao, and Dave McCormick are American heroes we can count on to stay true to their word and FIGHT for conservative principles and our shared Republican values in the Senate. **

[](http://links.teamnrsc.co/u/click?_t=aff6d619248e4524b6f468bb9c83f15c&_m=b1c2542db80545698c7a8ff6b3b5cbbf&_e=AOaaNd2ZLeVUE52E3lC5iNmfSdzx6KVzLLHby_RJMVZA1Urr8bflUeV9ogsf3jldd8Ek7HVe8L_a_O5UJ0rGw1MGvE2_9t2UBNECq8oydhvEGtuVwn_SccnNjoxL6EOP2MHyNocQRop_j0NDsVmNjubEvlHp-pCyV3amN7_SJYrbvI58POIMvcI3_MsfE87kfdKU8T_dZIhS3hFtUHewshVE5wNEaGTzMtBRlmxYDqtvVrnt5S8q8nSqQ6p8H4MuseFOZ0e_yfaklo0Y40TwX45MgaO-I3hDcbAkayKlgQCveLuOIL1fHd2epwybLpcoaJj_759bKV53bBAroBHXS4EBeMtV2PjWrsiWs6GHeAiWIgt-Dyq1AXVH-JPw158vnVW5SV7KHAVoUKAbJQcUfb34y_XQEk9I0qvyVO0X8mLOPcvOJpAssOJ6Vo2zn7JgX0uHcuXkW444RlXfLfxPRA_mD803lTsJWS1qJfWHCzc%3D)
