name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12703584?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

I’ve enjoyed a busy few weeks out in the community! I had the opportunity to attend events, meet with constituents, and learn more about how I can better serve **House District 24** in the legislature. As your **State Representative** , I’m fighting hard against the radical Left to preserve the conservative values at the heart of our great nation. I’m proud of all the good work I’ve accomplished for our state and district, and I look forward to continuing my work in the next legislative session.

If there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to get in touch with my office. I want to work with you to build a brighter future for Florida. **You can contact my office by[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b299258637&e=d1c1b9864f).** I look forward to hearing from you soon!
---
| | **Tuesday, July 30 - Marion County Building Industry Association Candidate Forum**
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to attend the **Marion County Building Industry Association Candidate Forum**. I attended in the capacity of an elected official to show my support for the candidates in our area who will be on the ballot this election. It was a perfect way to hear what platforms the candidates are running on and ask them questions important to voters.
---
| | **Wednesday, July 31 - YMCA’s Popsicles with Policy Makers Open House**
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| It was wonderful to attend **Frank Deluca’s YMCA’s Popsicles with Policy Makers Open House**. I had the opportunity to join Representative Stan McClain to spend time with our community’s young people and some of **Marion County** ’s future voters. To see how far **Frank DeLuca’s YMCA Family Center** has come as a result of our generous community is truly remarkable and inspiring.
---
| | **Wednesday, August 7 - Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony for New UF Health Location**
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| I had the pleasure of joining the community for the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new UF Health location at the **World Equestrian Center (WEC)**. This facility is a great asset to our area. This will allow those competing, visiting, or staying at WEC to receive care for minor illnesses and injuries. It also provides a retail pharmacy for animals and their owners and expert orthopedic care.
---
| | **Friday, August 9 - Tour of AdventHealth Ocala Hospital & On Top of the World Republican Club Meeting**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was an honor to tour **AdventHealth Ocala Hospital** and meet with CEO** Erika Skula**. I had the opportunity to hear about the programs that are in the works and their efforts to help their patients and staff. They are able to offer virtual nursing, which allows nurses to have the help they need with virtual assistance. I’m grateful for the care that Advent brings to our community and look forward to working with them in the future.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| That evening, I had the honor of speaking to the **On Top of the World Republican Club** and answering any questions that the members had, specifically involving the amendments that will be on the ballot this November.
---
|
---
| | Thank you for electing me to serve you in our state legislature! It has been an incredible honor to serve you and help build a brighter future for **Florida** and **House District 24**. I look forward to the progress we will make for our state in the future.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

body:
Big money has no place in our democracy, Peter.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240814-4204-footer&t=1&akid=4204%2E420207%2EtqDd4k)
Peter,
There’s no place for big money in politics — and it’s a scourge we must put a stop to this November.
Large corporations and special interests continue to abuse our democracy by straight up buying themselves seats in Congress. It’s not a sustainable way to run elections, and we all have to do our part to protect our democracy.
[**Can I count on you to pitch in $3 today so I can continue my work in Congress to take back our elections from large corporations and get big money out of politics?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240814.z-FjCn&refcode=em20240814-4204&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4204%2E420207%2EtqDd4k)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240814.z-FjCn&refcode=em20240814-4204&t=3&akid=4204%2E420207%2EtqDd4k)**
This is an issue we have to contend with **now**. This year, Republican megadonors gave tens of millions of dollars to AIPAC’s Super PAC to unseat two progressive Black members of Congress — Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush — because they called for a ceasefire.
Thanks to the fact that these special interests groups are allowed to raise and spend **unlimited amounts of money** , the House lost two incredible progressive leaders.
But I have faith that we can put our elections back in the hands of the people. When we take control of Congress, we’ll pass the For the People Act to bring transparency and accountability back to our democracy.
But while we have the momentum now, there’s still a long way to go until Election Day. And we’re going to need your help to keep it up until we get there.
**That’s why I’m asking for your grassroots support to power our movement — so we can take back Congress, win the White House, and finally pass legislation that will get big money out of politics.**
[**Please, can you make a contribution of $3 today to help put our elections back in the hands of the people?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240814.z-FjCn&refcode=em20240814-4204&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4204%2E420207%2EtqDd4k)

Together,
Pramila Jayapal

| Peter,

Here’s everything you need to know about the Left’s 2024 plan to retake the seats they lost in 2022:

* **Spend over $45 million** to spread lies about New York Republicans in battleground seats.
* Lean on their disgraced Hollywood megadonors to raise millions to line their candidates’ bank accounts.

_**Peter, my good friend and colleague Marc Molinaro, is at the top of their target list.**_

Making dinner and taking calls before my evening events — that's just the reality of being a working mom, friend!
As my campaign starts cooking with gas (pun fully intended 😉), I find myself taking solace in the normal moments at home. Don't get me wrong, I love being on the campaign trail, too: Talking to voters, traveling around Florida, running a battleground Senate race — I don't take a second of it for granted.

But here's what I also don't take for granted, friend: dinners at home with my three kids and husband, Sundays playing dominoes with my mom, and conversations with my children about what's been going on at school.
I love being a parent. But parents all over our nation — perhaps you, too, friend — share the same sinking feeling right now: Our kids are growing up in a country with fewer freedoms than we had at their age.

_I'm in this race to protect, restore, and defend our freedoms. To preserve our democracy. _

My opponent, Sen. Rick Scott, is directly responsible for confirming Supreme Court justices who have eviscerated reproductive rights and weakened voting rights. **_Ya no más — enough is enough._**
This is our greatest opportunity to defeat extremist Rick Scott and protect our democracy. His approval rating sits at an abysmal 35%, with election experts calling him one of the most vulnerable GOP senators on the ballot. **With Florida likely deciding Senate control, I'm fighting with everything I have to win and ensure my kids — and all kids — grow up with every freedom and opportunity to achieve their American dream.**

subject: These guys are weird

body:
Peter, thre are a lot of adjectives you could use to describe Donald Trump.
"Dishonest"
"Extreme"
"Erratic"
"Narcissistic"
"Authoritarian"
Just to name a few...
**But over the last few weeks, you may have heard another adjective, popularized by the new Democratic VP nominee, Gov. Tim Walz: WEIRD.**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90837726/491838567/-972800503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGFjM2MyNi04ZTVhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RUfqoMne2iBNkhiObMe2pBiZbogmekBZkyZLwgRkb7M=)**
Peter, let's be clear: Donald Trump and J.D. Vance are a clear threat to democracy—and their extreme agenda would do tremendous harm to working families and vulnerable communities.
**But on top of that...they're just creepy and weird.**
These guys want to tell women what they can do with their bodies. They want to tell us who we're allowed to love. They want to ban books, monitor women’s pregnancies, and enforce gender rules on kids**. **
They want to insert their extreme politics into our classrooms, our neighborhoods, and our kitchen tables. These aren't "conservative" policies. They're weird policies from weird dudes.
**You wouldn’t trust these guys to babysit your kids, let alone run the entire U.S. government.**

It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.
I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.
Because there is just too much at stake:
Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class.
Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.
Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues.
And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history.
So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election. Will you split a donation of $20 or more between Tim Kaine and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

In short: the real race begins now. We’re up against Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected.
He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.
It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.
I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record.
Will you become a General Election Founding Donor today and chip in $20 to Tim Kaine and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
Thank you for your support,
Elissa Slotkin

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1781%2E135344%2Ejmda8n)

Friend,
JD Vance – you know, the guy from Ohio trying to convince Michiganders to let him in the White House – just visited Michigan for the third time since he was named the Republican VP candidate a month ago.
He was back to fire up the far-right base and rally support for my opponent, Mike Rogers – and he called me out by name. But it was...kinda weird. He either deeply butchered my name, or tried to shoehorn the word “lie” into my name by calling me “El-LIE-za.” Either way, it just came off as awkward.
He knows that our campaign is the only thing stopping Republicans from flipping the Senate, and this is unfortunately not the last time he will use his platform to attack me.
I would so appreciate your help to fight back and keep Michigan blue in November. Please, use this link to donate now: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ebs-em-aug24](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240814-3-900&t=2&akid=1781%2E135344%2Ejmda8n)**
At his event today, Vance was flanked by my opponent, Mike Rogers, and emphasized how important this Senate race will be to Republicans not only controlling the Senate, but taking back the White House in November. JD Vance used his time here to advance lies about his and Trump’s agenda, while Mike Rogers highlighted culture war issues instead of speaking on issues that truly matter to Michiganders.
Today’s event is yet another indication that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.
No matter what anyone may tell you, Michigan is as swingy as it gets. And just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right on back.
[**We can't let that happen. Want to help? Chip in what you can and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump and JD Vance.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240814-3-900&t=3&akid=1781%2E135344%2Ejmda8n)
Thank you,
Elissa Slotkin

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxsj7Gu3CAQRb8Gd1h4YM1SUCR5cpdy064wDDEbsBHGazlfH9mKohSvvToz9x6Tcgz-0ER-JQBTcCsBIPwLAdgq_2Eej-_loEtWdOeAZ0zgGwGoR8Z_5N8nLSYT4pnKj8ZpAabztkHdSeC97OGmmkkb0YNgvPNSqDsaUAbB3EZ_dyi542MTNDAQ7N4JgJvk0DJ0glmlmOKjl8oTwa6i1hfEOoX5FxZnQjxau6Qm6qnWvF7DBgLDinYr2O5hLuhOgsBQy5YynU0Ny2witUtKoVZE-vKWwBAzzWXN9Gqhu4m_aQoxVFMO-n456kbCh62mZ8WSCP9wI62zpZg6BZQxSaBfl61YfNrF4efAf-e-uq4p2uU9xBjWXhLBfl6Cp89bw58AAAD__yYug9Y)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**

clean_body: I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq | | | | | Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me. I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind. Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream. When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into. But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life. Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable. I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies. My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation. We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility. That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs. President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support. My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part. I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation. If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST. Thank you and may God bless you, JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. clean_body: | | | | == | == | Early Voting Starts September 20 | | Friends, We are staying busy on the campaign trail. There is so much at stake this election. Please remind folks early voting begins 20 September and Election Day is 5 November. Here is some of what we have been up to: | Elisabeth Foley, Hanover, Survives Shark Attack | | | | We first met Feb 2023. | One of our amazing constituents in Hanover County needs our help. She is a home school mother whom I first met in 2023, Elisabeth Foley. Elisabeth fought off a viscous bull shark attack while on a Florida vacation in June with her husband and three children. She was bitten in both of her upper legs, her buttocks, and the attack severed her left hand. Through prayer, surgeries, and determination she is still with us. I sat down with Elisabeth, her husband Ryan, and mother in law Judy at their home to pray and discuss the challenges ahead that include more surgeries. She said she prayed to God to save her during the attack. Elisabeth may have lost her left hand, but she has not lost her faith in our Lord and her positive outlook on life. Please consider helping Elisabeth through their go fund me page: == Brandon Scott, Powhatan County, New Song Southern Love | == | Check out Powhatan resident Brandon Scott's new song on Youtube. Click here: == | Governor Youngkin Improves Election Integrity | == | "Today, I am issuing this Executive Order to ensure the accurate, transparent and reliable use of data among state agencies, aiming to achieve best-in-class voter list maintenance processes for the Commonwealth," said Governor Youngkin. "As we transition to a new statewide voter registration system, it is imperative that every state agency provides accurate and valid data. This Executive Order continues our improvements to list maintenance processes, providing a reliable election system for voters." == | VA Loggers Association Annual Meeting | | | | Senator Danny Diggs and Delegate Buddy Fowler | | Mecklenburg County Friends! | | | Delegate Otto Wachsmann | | Thank you Ron Jenkins, and the VA Loggers Association for inviting me to the VA Loggers Association Annual meeting. Forestry is the 3rd largest industry in Virginia; generating more than $21 billion annually and employing more than 100,000 people. We need to do more incentivize local businesses to buy local lumber. | National Wild Turkey Federation | | | | | | | | | | | | | My wife Tracy and I had a great time at the National Wild Turkey Federation Seminol Trail Longbeards Banquet on Saturday evening in Madison Heights, Amherst County. There was great food and even better conversation. There are approximately 253,650 hunters in Virginia and we need to protect our hunting heritage. | 5th District Trump HQ Opening | | | | | | | I had a great time on Sunday celebrating the grand opening of the Farmville Trump Office! We had an amazing crowd full of people who are fired up and ready to help President Trump in November. Thank you to the 5th District Trump Team for putting this amazing event together. | RIP Roxane Gilmore | == | Our thoughts and prayers are with Governor Jim Gilmore and the family at the passing of his wife former Virginia First Lady Roxane Gilmore. She was a teacher and professor who served as first lady of Virginia during Jim Gilmore's term as governor from 1998 to 2002. She died Wednesday at age 70. Roxane Gilmore's dedication to Virginia and education leave big shoes to fill. She was our neighbor, a patriot, and a friend. Roxane and Jim Gilmore once paddled across the James River in one of our black inflatable rafts during one of my SEAL Team PT fitness classes. She will be missed. Governor of Virginia said "Virginia's iconic Executive Mansion will always be her legacy". == | WWII Veteran Returned to Lynchburg | | | | | | | | Nearly 80 years after his death, U.S. Army Sgt. Mayburn Hudson was laid to rest in his hometown of Lynchburg, VA last Wednesday, August 7th. As a Veteran I'm glad I was able to be there as a true American hero was reunited with his family and put to rest in his hometown. Our men and women in the military are heroes and should always be treated as such, in life and in death. == | Drumheller Orchard | | | I met with Doris, Morgan, Kevin, Jesse, Thomas, and David at Drumheller Orchard. Thank you Doris, Morgan, and Kevin Drumheller for showing me around on August 14th. I enjoyed walking the property and hearing about the issues that affect the agriculture community. | Powhatan Trump Force 47 | | | | | Volunteer training in Powhatan. Early voting begins 20 September and Election Day is 5 November. Please spread the word! | Vietnam War Museum, Nelson County | | | | Thank you USMC Vietnam veteran Larry Saunders for showing me around the Vietnam War Museum. I recommend anyone who finds themselves in Nelson County on Highway 29 to go check it out! | Campbell County GOP Committee Meeting | | | | | We gave out signs and met some wonderful people at the Campbell County GOP meeting. It was an honor to speak and give an update on the campaign. We must unite and help all Republicans win in November! Central Republican Women's Club | Thank you Lynn Tucker for inviting me to the Central Republican Women's meeting in Campbell County. | Saunders Brothers Since 1915 | | | | | | Thank you, Jim Saunders, for showing me around the farm, and sharing your concerns about agriculture in Virginia. | Mountain and Vine Vineyard | | | | | It was nice meeting Michael and Adrian Albers and their dog Buck jr. Mountain and Vine vineyard received the Governor's Cup award this year! | Lydia's Barber Shop Nelson County | | | If you are in Nelson County near Wintergreen stop by and see Lydia if you need a haircut | BBQ With Our Hunters! | | | | | | | We are making friends all over the district. Thank you to our hunters for inviting me. The BBQ was great. Please remind friends early voting starts 20 September. | Reincarnated a 2nd Hand Specialty Shop | | Tracy and I enjoyed visiting Kerry Thornton at her store in Nelson County. | Making Friends Round the 5th Congressional District | | | | | | | McGuire Fundraiser In Lynchburg | | I look forward to my fundraiser with Governor Glenn Youngkin on Monday, 19 August. Thank you to Sheriff Mike & Dr. Janet Brown, Melanie & Lynch Christian, Martha & Walter Curt, Betty & Ben Davenport, Delegate James Edmunds, Vice Mayor Chris Faraldi, Jill & John Fees, Jennifer & Watt Foster, Delegate Buddy Fowler, Elizabeth & Mike Harrington, Henry & Margaret Hurt, The Hon. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why I'm asking before tomorrow
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is a trend that continues repeating itself in elections across the country

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2310%2E4032634%2ECJpUUB)
---
We’ve got an important fundraising deadline _tonight_ in Massachusetts — and anything you’re able to contribute to our re-election campaign before the deadline will be a huge help. Your support at this time is powerfully important, because I’m competing against a Republican crypto lawyer that was recruited from Rhode Island and has a Super PAC funneling millions of dollars in this race. I don’t have a Super PAC to turn to when we need campaign donations. That’s not my style. The only way we can show that we’re competitive, fight back, and defeat them is through donations to this email. [**So if you’re able to, any amount you can donate before tonight’s deadline will help our campaign secure the resources we need to compete, and will help demonstrate the strength of our campaign on our next fundraising report. Can you make a donation before tonight’s deadline?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2554?t=8&akid=2310%2E4032634%2ECJpUUB)

---
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_ |

| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2554?t=20&express_lane=true&akid=2310%2E4032634%2ECJpUUB)
---

---
This is a trend that continues repeating itself in elections across the country. Powerful special interests use their piles of money to fund campaigns and support Super PACs for politicians that will bow to them and work in their favor. They use their money to hire armies of lobbyists that swarm Capitol Hill. They use their money to put the government on their side, all so they can make even bigger piles of money. But we’ve got a powerful tool on our side too: a grassroots movement. In the long run, to make our country work not just for a thin slice at the tippy-top but for everyone, we’ve got to overturn Citizens United and enact sweeping anti-corruption legislation (yes, I’ve got a plan for that). **But for now, we’ve got to shore up our defenses against Super PAC spending and anything else the far right throws at us. Together, we’ll keep working to stop big money from drowning out the voices of working families. But first, we need to secure the resources we need to fight back and win re-election.** [**Not everyone who reads this note will be able to chip in, and that’s okay. But if you are in the position to make a donation tonight, it would be a huge help.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2554?t=14&akid=2310%2E4032634%2ECJpUUB) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

_**Right now, we’re genuinely the underdogs. According to the most recently released public poll, this race is tied. That’s why I had the honor of welcoming the President to Montana Friday evening. He’s all-in for Montana, and we’re all-in for him.**_

name: Jen Kiggans, Navy Veteran
subject: My call sign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=30c9f9f7fcdc48659b499201c47f8536&_e=RxuKciiW6Qzpj4sfU02Amc4y18Wds-tQ6R7Y4iJapHikAtXQjnTeoGNmwIRFDVeHwiXkTvleR1Rt4_hOWd055SQr_XMMmD-hep_2aVKcqIbK5iFmXKY8kKTd2MOB6SrzuvcH_5Z9bSkUMJtLKORS3qDf0ho-6xAZZlAD26Q15IgHfkVAGpuvPv5Bfqt9HeVNTYEukxt13kjLkeHKrIUAUkQih17ODHDbKi9RXZIvS8xBPiCraExPEVLpPkNfFfyz_rgL4TVpRJ-uFLYNNI12KqyVy1mYg43pOJKAs8Y5qbnMJk8P6Y5C-F2yQ92Iu6y6DPyd6s5_WkU82zwbZ82GaDCw3zFmP21S-6Gn3DoLmPYdRYgv8Mk4uFLBGgxLG6MYM7Yk61v7q5Q6dKxjrRoDs5U-EjliqbAWUrh8FLDjEx7_am5eWwbgEprkVTY82TTJ)
---

That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom**.

People often ask...how did I get that name?

Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.

There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.

Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!

It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service.

Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service.

As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.

**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about _service_.**

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39027%2E3422442%2E9XoFUz)
Derek,
I want to share a story about why it’s important we have moms of young kids representing us in Congress.
When we expanded the Child Tax Credit during the pandemic, there were stricter income limits on single parent households than on married households. I call it the Single Parent Penalty.
From a policy perspective, this penalty makes no sense! There’s no “single parent discount” for groceries, kids’ shoes, rent, or childcare. By punishing single parent families, we punish the children whose families are often most in need of assistance.
I asked Congressional staffers and my colleagues why we have the Single Parent Penalty in the first place. **They told me, “No one’s asked about it before.”**
That might be because no single mom of young kids had ever been elected to Congress—until I won in 2018.
When we elect people to the halls of power who share our experiences, they make policies that work better for all Americans.
Truth to Power endorses candidates who will fight for what families need, not what corporate special interests want. And, we’ve partnered with Vote Mama, an organization that supports moms of young kids running for office. Together, we’re working to elect people like Raquel Terán in Arizona, a mom and community advocate, to be a voice for families in Congress.
We need more people in Washington who are willing to ask tough questions, challenge the status quo, and directly confront the biggest challenges families are facing.
**[Will you split a contribution today between Truth to Power and Vote Mama to help us elect more leaders with diverse experiences that reflect the American people?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240814?refcode=em20240814-39027&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39027_3422442_9XoFUz&akid=39027%2E3422442%2E9XoFUz)**
Thank you,
Katie

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: There’s no one else we can count on
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Ruben Gallego
#

Hey Peter, last email for today here.
Listen, when I was first thinking about running for Arizona’s Senate seat last year I really didn’t know what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters and friends I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that I would need a massive team behind me. More than a year and a half later, we’ve built that team. More than 300,000 people have chipped in to my campaign, and I’m incredibly proud of that.
Over the last few months I’ve learned just how important this team really is. Your voice and your support have had a huge impact.
But beyond you and our other supporters there just aren’t many people we can count on. Nobody else is coming to save the day. We don’t have an army of millionaires and billionaires coming to drop pallets of cash on us, and I wouldn’t run my campaign that way even if it was an option.
